jobs.title: Field Auditor - Asaba
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are looking for an experienced Field Auditor to join our team in Nigeria, to influence how audit findings impact customer trust and business performance.


The Role

As a Field Auditor, you will visit field locations, test whether operations match policy and regulation, and turn what you find into clear recommendations. You will work with teams across the business to make sure fixes are implemented.

Growing from millions to ten million customers means more field activity, more locations and more processes that must hold up under pressure. We are deliberately building stronger assurance to match that scale, and Field Auditor is a key part of it.



About M-KOPA

M-KOPA is a pan-African fintech that makes financial inclusion real. We finance everyday assets like smartphones and e-motorbikes for people that traditional finance has overlooked. We now serve 10 million customers across Africa and have extended over $2 billion in credit.



This is an on-site role, you would be working from our offices in Nigeria, partnering with a diverse group of employees from our different markets and locations across the UK, Europe and Africa. You will be reporting to the Senior Field Auditor.

What You'll Do

  • Conduct field audits at various locations and review operational procedures and documents

  • Ensure compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements

  • Identify discrepancies, inefficiencies and areas for improvement, and run risk assessments with mitigation strategies

  • Recommend corrective action and follow up until it is implemented

  • Help develop and deliver field audit plans, completing assignments on time

  • Prepare detailed audit reports, present findings to stakeholders and work with other departments to gather what you need


What You'll Need

  • Minimum 2-3 years of demonstrable experience in stock management and operations auditing, including retail audits, inventory variance analysis and compliance checks in similar environments

  • A Bachelor’s degree in any field. Your audit expertise and operational acumen matter more than the subject

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, with Excel and Word essential for data analysis and report preparation

  • A sharp eye for detail and strong organisational skills: you catch inconsistencies others miss, juggle overlapping timelines and keep clear schedules and task systems

  • Clear, professional communication by email, phone and in person with a wide range of stakeholders

  • Self-direction and integrity: you work independently without micromanagement, bring a strong work ethic and strictly follow company anti-bribery and corruption policies




The Reality

This role requires precision under pressure. You'll work with tight deadlines, manage multiple audit schedules simultaneously, and navigate field contexts across Nigeria. You'll balance detailed documentation with field problem-solving. You'll operate independently, often in retail environments with competing demands.

Why M-KOPA?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.

Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at m-kopa.com.

Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026), named on CNBC's World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025 & 2026 and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 10 million customers, unlocking $2 billion in cumulative credit for the everyday earners across Africa, in addition to over 10,000 e-bikes financed in Kenya.

Important Notice

M-KOPA is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to assembling a diverse, broadly trained staff. Women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.

M-KOPA explicitly prohibits the use of Forced or Child Labour and respects the rights of its employees to agree to terms and conditions of employment voluntarily, without coercion, and freely terminate their employment on appropriate notice. M-KOPA shall ensure that its Employees are of legal working age and shall comply with local laws for youth employment or student work, such as internships or apprenticeships. 

M-KOPA does not collect/charge any money as a pre-employment or post-employment requirement. This means that we never ask for ‘recruitment fees’, ‘processing fees’, ‘interview fees’, or any other kind of money in exchange for offer letters or interviews at any time during the hiring process.

Applications for this position will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisting and interviews will take place at any stage during the recruitment process. We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if a suitable candidate is selected before the advertised closing date.

If your application is successful M-KOPA undertakes pre-employment background checks as part of its recruitment process, these include; criminal records, identification verification, academic qualifications, employment dates and employer references.

jobs.title: Mobility Quality Analyst
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Mobility Quality Analyst to monitor, evaluate, and continuously improve the quality of customer interactions across M-KOPA Mobility's contact center operations. This is a high-impact role where your work directly shapes the service experience for thousands of customers across Kenya.

"This role is for someone who is analytical but also deeply invested in people development. You'll be working across quality monitoring, reporting, coaching, and process improvement — helping the team get better every single day through data, feedback, and practical insight."

About Us

At M-KOPA, we're focused on digital and financial inclusion across Africa, serving over 3 million "everyday earners" through pay-as-you-go asset financing. Our Mobility division is expanding access to electric motorbikes, helping riders transition to cleaner, more cost-effective transportation solutions.

What You'll Do

• Conduct comprehensive quality assessments of customer interactions across calls, chats, and social media

• Evaluate agent performance against quality standards, KPIs, and compliance requirements

• Review ride disputes, cancellations, safety incidents, and escalated customer issues

• Monitor adherence to scripts, processes, and company policies

• Perform calibration sessions with team leads to ensure consistency in scoring

• Analyze quality metrics and trends to identify patterns in agent performance and customer pain points

• Generate detailed quality scorecards and performance reports for agents and team leaders

• Track and report on metrics including CSAT, FCR, AHT, compliance rates, and quality scores

• Provide data-driven insights and recommendations for process improvements

• Deliver constructive feedback to agents through one-on-one coaching sessions

• Identify skill gaps and develop training materials based on quality findings

• Partner with operations teams to refine quality frameworks and evaluation criteria

• Support root cause analysis for recurring quality issues

This is an on-site role based at our offices in Nairobi. You will be reporting to the Customer Care Manager.

Expertise

• Minimum 2 years of experience in quality assurance within a contact center environment

• Previous experience in mobility, ride-sharing, transportation, or on-demand services is preferred

• Background in customer service operations or agent coaching is a plus

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights

• Excellent communication skills — both written and verbal

• A collaborative approach with the ability to give and receive feedback constructively

If the above is of interest to you, please apply.

Why M-KOPA?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.

jobs.title: Sourcing Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Sourcing Manager to join our Warehouse Logistics & Supply Chain team as we scale up and drive digital and financial inclusion across our markets.

You’re accomplished at sourcing. You’ve cut unit costs and kept supply steady. But what if the phones you buy decided whether someone gets their first smartphone?

M-KOPA serves 7 million customers and has unlocked $2+ billion in credit. 86% report a better quality of life, and 55% are accessing these products for the first time. Phones and accessories are our largest area of spend, and we’re growing toward 10 million customers. That’s why we’re hiring a Group Sourcing Manager now.

About Us

We foster a culture where commercial sharpness meets customer-centricity. Our team values data-driven decision-making, disciplined execution, and leadership that creates urgency without compromising customer trust. You'll be empowered to design campaigns, coach Team Leaders, improve processes, and drive conversion metrics that directly contribute to M-KOPA Uganda's growth and customer loyalty. Working at one of Africa's fastest-growing fintechs—recognized by the Financial Times four years running and TIME100 Most Influential Companies—your work impacts millions of Ugandan customers and the business that serves them.

At M-KOPA, our Retention Manager isn't just a telesales manager—they're the architect of a high-accountability sales culture that protects customer relationships while consistently driving repeat business and revenue growth.

What you’ll do

  • Build the Group sourcing strategy for smartphones, feature phones and accessories, and turn sales forecasts into a 12-month plan agreed with Supply Chain and Finance. Run tenders with OEMs, ODMs and distributors, and negotiate price, volume tiers, MOQs, lead times, warranty, Incoterms, payment terms and FX exposure using landed-cost models.

  • Draft and renew supply agreements with Legal, run quarterly supplier reviews on price, delivery and quality (DOA and field-failure rates), and manage supply risk, from dual-sourcing and factory audits to counterfeit risk and type approvals.

  • Keep procurement controls and records audit-ready, report device cost per unit and savings to Group Finance monthly, and lead and coach a team of three.

What you bring

  • Extensive progressive experience in sourcing or procurement, with substantial time in mobile phones, consumer electronics or accessories, negotiating directly with OEMs, ODMs or tier-1 distributors, and a proven record of high-value hardware contracts with documented savings.

  • Strong landed-cost, Incoterms, duties and FX skills, with working knowledge of device quality (DOA, warranty, RMA) and electronics supply risk.

  • Advanced Excel, ERP or procurement system experience (Dynamics a bonus), a relevant degree, and the ability to influence senior stakeholders and push back with data.

Helpful, not essential: MCIPS or equivalent; device financing, telecoms or emerging-market electronics experience; type-approval knowledge; familiarity with device-locking software; Mandarin or on-site experience with Asian manufacturers.

The reality check: it’s demanding, with multiple markets, FX and supply shocks to manage. You’re probably ready for it.

Curious? Let’s talk.

Why M-KOPA?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.

Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at m-kopa.com.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are looking for Sales Executives to join our Sales Team as we scale up and drive digital and financial inclusion across our markets.

 

Field sales experience. Team leadership instincts. A market ready to grow.

M-KOPA has reached 7 million customers across Africa, unlocking $2 billion in credit for people the traditional financial system has overlooked. 86% of those customers report an improved quality of life. The products—smartphones, e-motorbikes—aren't just purchases. They change what's economically possible for the people who access them.

That reach is built by people on the ground, including Sales Executives.

What the role involves

This is a player-coach position with two equally weighted mandates.

On the personal sales side: building a strong local network across the area, identifying growth opportunities, and consistently meeting and exceeding individual sales targets—with every customer interaction reflecting the trust M-KOPA has earned as a brand.

On the team leadership side: recruiting, onboarding, training, and developing a field team of Direct Sales Representatives, monitoring their performance, and building their capability to exceed targets over time. The team's results are a direct measure of the quality of leadership they receive.

The role also covers local marketing campaign monitoring, DSR inventory management, audit compliance, and the reporting that shapes how M-KOPA's sales strategy develops in the market.

What we're looking for

Proven track record in field sales, with demonstrable experience in FinTech, Microfinance, Telecommunications, FMCG, or a related sector and a clear record of exceeding individual targets.

Demonstrated experience leading or mentoring a field-based sales team, with the ability to recruit well, develop capability, and drive accountability.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Sales Executive to join our Sales Team, as we scale up and drive digital and financial inclusion across our markets.


This isn't a territory management job dressed up in mission language. As a Sales Executive at M-KOPA Ghana, you'll be the engine behind a field team of Direct Sales Representatives - recruiting them, training them, coaching them, and driving them toward targets that actually mean something. The customers your team reaches aren't switching providers for a better deal. For many of them, this is the first time anyone has offered them credit at all.

We're in active expansion mode, moving from 7 million toward 10 million customers. The infrastructure being built right now, the teams, the networks, the local market strategies will define how fast we get there. You'd be joining at exactly the moment when what you build has the most to shape.


About Us

M-KOPA is a fintech company built on a simple but radical idea that financial inclusion shouldn't be a privilege. Today, we've unlocked over $2 billion in credit for more than 7 million customers across Africa, with 86% reporting an improved quality of life and 55% accessing financial products for the very first time. With 2,300+ employees and 35,000 agents operating across multiple markets, we're not a startup finding its feet — we're a scaled business in the middle of its most ambitious growth phase yet. Ghana is a critical part of that story.

This is a hybrid role, you would be working from our offices in Ghana, partnering with a diverse group of employees from our different markets and locations across the UK, Europe and Africa. You will be reporting to the Regional Manager.

What You'll Do

  • Recruit, train, coach and supervise a field-based team of Direct Sales Representatives, monitoring their performance consistently against M-KOPA's standards while managing DSR inventory and resolving audit recommendations in line with company guidelines.

  • Design and execute the sales and marketing strategy for your territory, setting the direction for weekly, monthly, and quarterly target achievement while monitoring and analyzing the performance of marketing campaigns.

  • Deliver and exceed sales targets across your designated territory by developing strong local networks that uphold M-KOPA's brand values and retail point standards.

What you'll bring

  • Demonstrable experience in sales within microfinance, insurance, telecommunications, mobile money, FMCG, or related sectors in Ghana, with a proven track record of hitting and exceeding targets.

  • Established expertise in recruiting, coaching, and leading field-based sales teams; you know how to get performance from people, not just compliance.

  • Proven ability to design and execute territory-level sales and marketing strategies that translate into consistent weekly, monthly, and quarterly results.

The honest part

This role operates in the field, across communities that aren't always easy to reach. The targets are real, the accountability is direct, and the pace reflects a business that's scaling fast. If you're energized by that rather than exhausted by reading it, that's probably worth paying attention to.

jobs.title: Warehouse Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Warehouse Manager to own the day-to-day integrity, security, and control environment of M-KOPA’s warehouse and inbound/outbound logistics operations in Kenya.

This role offers the opportunity to be the site-level custodian of warehouse controls at one of Africa’s fastest-growing fintechs, owning everything from inventory discipline and customs compliance to people development and third-party relationships. You’ll enforce disciplined storage and inventory controls, keep imports and clearing activity compliant with customs and regulatory requirements, drive down obsolete and ageing stock, and build a capable, well-managed warehouse and logistics team. Working closely with Finance, the Head of Manufacturing, and cross-functional stakeholders, your decisions protect the organisation from compliance risk, stock loss, and operational inefficiency every single day.

About Us

We foster a culture where operational discipline meets continuous improvement. Our team values inventory accuracy, compliance rigor, and warehouse leadership that builds accountability into every process. You’ll be empowered to enforce controls, develop your team, and drive improvements that directly contribute to operational efficiency and business performance, working in a fast-paced environment where your standards determine how well the entire supply chain operates.

At M-KOPA, our warehouse isn’t just a storage facility—it’s a critical operational hub that keeps devices moving to millions of customers across Africa, and the controls you enforce protect the integrity of every transaction that flows through it.

In this role, you would be responsible for:

Warehouse Space & Racking Controls

  • Ensuring rented warehouse racks and paid storage space are used exclusively for items of value—finished goods, saleable inventory, and materials with recognised book value

  • Conducting periodic rack utilisation audits and reallocating or clearing any rented space holding non-qualifying items

  • Maintaining an accurate rack/bin-location map always reconciled against the WMS/ERP system

Marketing Merchandise Control

  • Ensuring every category of marketing merchandise held in the warehouse is covered by a signed Service Level Agreement (SLA) specifying the goods-in receiving process, required documentation, and maximum allowable storage period

  • Tracking merchandise against SLA storage limits and proactively flagging, escalating, and clearing any merchandise approaching or exceeding its maximum storage time

  • Declining to receive marketing merchandise where no valid SLA exists, escalating to management before accepting any exception

Inventory Ageing & Obsolescence Management

  • Collaborating with Finance to produce and publish a monthly Inventory Ageing Report, giving management full visibility of inventory at risk

  • Reviewing the ageing report monthly with Finance and relevant stakeholders to agree corrective actions and track them to closure

  • Fully implementing the company Disposal Policy, ensuring obsolete, damaged, or written-off items are continually identified and disposed of within policy timelines with complete documentation and approvals

  • Maintaining a disposal register/tracker and reporting disposal volumes, values, and ageing trends to management monthly

Imports & Logistics Compliance

  • Coordinating inbound logistics with clearing agents, customs authorities, and government bodies to ensure smooth, compliant, and timely clearance of goods across borders

  • Ensuring all import documentation (bills of lading, customs declarations, duty remission paperwork, permits) is accurate, complete, and audit-ready

  • Executing duty remission and applicable customs schemes accurately, monitoring compliance conditions on an ongoing basis to protect the organisation from retrospective duty claims or penalties

  • Escalating any compliance risk, customs query, or regulatory exposure to management and Finance/Legal without delay

  • Establishing and enforcing standards for outbound logistics to ensure timely, accurate, and properly documented delivery of products

Inventory & Warehouse Operations

  • Enforcing day-to-day inventory management practices (goods-in, put-away, picking, cycle counts, stock reconciliation) that ensure accuracy, transparency, and audit-readiness of stock records

  • Leading root-cause investigation and corrective action on stock discrepancies, shrinkage, or unexplained variances

  • Driving continuous improvement in warehouse processes to reduce cost, error rates, and turnaround time without compromising control

3rd Party Relations Management

  • Ensuring 3rd party SLAs—including courier services and order processing—are adhered to fully without compromise

  • Ensuring warehouse-related 3rd party contracts and agreements are renewed and updated on time

  • Ensuring all claims to 3rd parties are lodged accurately and on time

  • Regularly verifying that billing done by 3rd parties for warehouse and logistics functions is accurate and timely

People Management

  • Training, coaching, and professionally developing all warehouse and logistics staff including Warehouse/Inventory Officers, Reverse Logistics Officers, Imports & Logistics Officers, and casual/contract staff

  • Setting clear performance objectives, conducting regular performance reviews, and managing underperformance fairly and promptly

  • Building a culture of accountability, integrity, and continuous improvement within the warehouse and logistics team

  • Planning shift and resource coverage to always ensure adequate supervision and segregation of duties

Health, Safety & Compliance

  • Ensuring all warehouse and logistics activities comply with health and safety regulations and company policies

  • Ensuring the warehouse passes internal and external audits (finance, health & safety, customs) with no material findings

  • Owning and closing out audit action points within agreed timelines

This is a managerial role (Job Band C2) based in Nairobi, Kenya, within the Warehouse & Logistics department. If successful, you would be reporting to the Head of Manufacturing. Your direct reports include Warehouse Officers, Reverse Logistics Officers, and Imports & Logistics Officers.

Your application should demonstrate:

Required Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree (B.Com/BSc) in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field

  • 5–8 years of progressive experience in warehouse, logistics, or supply chain management

  • At least 2 years in a supervisory or managerial role

  • Demonstrated experience in inventory controls, customs clearance, duty remission schemes, and cross-border logistics

Required Skills

  • Strong knowledge of customs regulations, clearing procedures, and duty remission schemes, with ability to liaise effectively with clearing agents, customs authorities, and government bodies

  • Demonstrated ability to enforce inventory and warehouse controls including racking discipline, SLA management, ageing analysis, and disposal policy execution

  • Good understanding of finance procedures for stock valuation, ageing reporting, and disposal sign-off

  • Excellent organisational and planning skills with strong attention to detail and accuracy

  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, and numerical skills

  • High proficiency in spreadsheet and data processing tools including Excel and Dynamics 365

  • Strong leadership and people-management skills with a track record of developing and managing teams professionally

  • Exceptional work ethic and integrity — you enforce controls even when it’s inconvenient

  • Self-motivated with ability to prioritise and manage competing deadlines in a fast-paced environment

Preferred Skills & Qualifications

  • Working knowledge of duty remission and customs bonded warehousing schemes within East Africa

  • Experience operating an ERP/WMS platform (e.g., Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP, or similar)

  • Familiarity with Lean, 5S, or continuous improvement methodologies in a warehousing environment

  • Prior exposure to FMCG, manufacturing, or distribution supply chains operating in African markets

  • Professional certification such as CIPS, CILT, or APICS/CSCP is an added advantage

jobs.title: Senior Sales Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Senior Sales Manager (Alternate & Indirect Channel) — M-KOPA Ghana

You've hit your numbers. You've led managers who hit theirs. But have you ever built the channel from the ground up — recruitment, incentives, systems and all — rather than inheriting one that already worked?

Most senior sales roles ask you to run a channel someone else designed. This one asks you to build it: nationwide, across every region in Ghana, spanning two very different sales motions at once.

M-KOPA now serves 7 million customers across Africa, having unlocked over $2 billion in credit, with 86% of customers reporting improved quality of life and 70% using our products to generate income. Behind those numbers sit 35,000+ agents and a distribution engine that has to keep working, region by region, shop by shop. This role owns two critical pieces of that engine in Ghana: the Alternate Channel (dealer and community shops) and the Telco Indirect network — both nationwide, both yours to grow.

Why this timing matters

M-KOPA is scaling from 7 million customers toward 10 million, and Ghana's channel infrastructure needs to be built for that next phase, not just maintained for this one. That's why this role exists now: not to manage an established, steady-state operation, but to define how alternate and indirect distribution should work at national scale, then build the team and systems to make it real.

What makes this different

This isn't a single-channel job. You'll be accountable for two distinct distribution models — dealer/community shops and telco indirect outlets — each with its own partners, incentive logic, and performance rhythm, and you'll be expected to find the synergies between them rather than run them as separate silos. You'll also sit closer to strategic decision-making than most sales management roles: building the business case and ROI model for channel investment, shaping national commission structures with the Strategy team, and — as you prove yourself — stepping in to support Regional Managers or lead cross-regional initiatives. It's a role explicitly designed with room to grow into broader sales leadership, not a fixed lane.

What you'll need to bring

  • Demonstrable experience leading field sales teams through other managers — not just individual contributors — ideally including exposure to fintech, FMCG, telecoms, or consumer finance environments where high-volume, target-driven execution is the norm.

  • Proven track record delivering sales targets in geographically dispersed, high-volume field environments, with the analytical rigour to read scorecards and performance trends and turn them into decisive regional and resourcing calls.

  • A track record building or scaling distribution channels and partner networks — recruitment, onboarding, incentive design, and partner relationship management at more than a local level.

What the work actually looks like

Some weeks are about the numbers: reviewing scorecards, diagnosing which regions are underperforming and why, and reallocating resources before a small gap becomes a big one. Others are about the field: spending structured time on the ground, in shops and with telco partners, resolving what's actually blocking activation rather than waiting for it to surface in a report. You'll be negotiating commission structures with the Strategy team one week and sitting across the table from a national telco partner the next, aligning on joint targets and in-shop standards. And as Regional Managers around you develop, you'll be coaching them, occasionally stepping in to cover a gap, and building the leadership pipeline the business will need as it scales.

The honest version

This role carries real weight from day one: two channels, multiple regions, and accountability for outcomes you won't always control directly, since much of the work runs through partners and managers rather than your own hands. It suits someone who's energised by building rather than maintaining, who's comfortable making calls with incomplete information and adjusting fast, and who wants visible line of sight into where this role goes next — because the broader sales leadership exposure here is real, not a talking point.

Let's talk

If building a national channel from first principles — and having real influence over where it goes next — sounds more exciting than inheriting one that's already finished, we'd like to talk. No pressure to have every detail buttoned up before you reach out.

Why M-KOPA?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.

Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at m-kopa.com.

Join our expanding Workplace Engineering team! We’re recruiting a Head of Workplace Engineering to run IT at M-KOPA as a product, with automation first, so 2,500+ colleagues can keep serving Africa’s Every Day Earners.

The Impact

🏆 Global recognition: Named by TIME 100 as one of the world’s most influential companies, and by the Financial Times as one of Africa’s fastest-growing for four consecutive years (2022-2025).

🚀 Scale challenges: Run IT across six countries, from call-centre agents to the executive team, using repeatable, templated builds for new sites and markets.

🌱 Environmental impact: We’re carbon-negative, with over 2 million tonnes of emissions avoided.

What You’ll Do

You’ll lead our IT function, including the Helpdesk and IT Infrastructure teams, and be accountable for the cost, security, reliability and user experience of our internal estate. We’re not hiring a traditional IT manager. We want an engineer who would rather write the automation than raise the ticket.

  • Own the IT roadmap and budget, treating internal services as products with clear users and measured adoption

  • Run the corporate Azure and Microsoft estate as code, deployed through CI/CD

  • Automate joiner/mover/leaver, device provisioning, licensing and access requests, driven from the HR system of record

  • Own identity, end-user devices, networks across all our sites, and contact-centre telephony across ~10 call centres

  • Move support from reactive tickets to self-service and automated resolution, using AI and agentic tooling where it genuinely removes work

  • Own IT security hygiene, business continuity and compliance, with audit evidence generated from systems

  • Microsoft and cloud: Azure, Entra ID, Intune, M365

  • Scripting: PowerShell, Python, TypeScript or similar

  • Integrations: APIs and workflow tooling across HR, identity, ITSM and finance systems

  • Automation first, everything versioned and repeatable

  • Data over anecdote

  • A team that builds rather than firefights

  • Deep Azure and Microsoft experience: Entra ID, Intune, M365, Azure networking and core services

  • Hands-on infrastructure as code with Bicep and/or Terraform in production

  • A track record of automating IT operations at scale, with the before and after to show for it

  • Experience leading teams, including non-engineering teams such as a service desk

  • Approachable: you explain technical trade-offs in plain language and build trust at every level

Probably not a fit if your experience is mainly managing vendors and tickets rather than building.

  • Based in Nigeria, Kenya, South Africa, Ghana, Uganda, the UK or the EU, with significant travel of up to 25% at times, especially early in the role

  • Benefits package, which includes Bonus & Growth Shares

  • Work with diverse teams across the UK, Europe and Africa

  • Professional development programmes and coaching partnerships

  • Family-friendly policies and flexible working arrangements

  • Well-being support and career growth opportunities

Our Mission 🌍

We create financial inclusion for the traditionally excluded through a fair, flexible, customer-centric financing model. We strive to drive greater inclusion of women, youth and low-income communities.

Our Impact 💚

  • Connected 📱: 2.5 million first-time smartphone users connected to the mobile internet

  • Prosperous 💰: 70% of customers use their M-KOPA product to generate income, and 35,000 livelihoods created for agents

  • Green 🌱: 2.1 million tonnes of CO₂ avoided, with over 127,000 circular economy products provided

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Mobility
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Join our expanding Mobility engineering team! We’re actively recruiting a Senior Backend Engineer as M-KOPA Mobility, our fast-growing e-mobility business, which has a 3x year-on-year growth rate! Build the event-driven microservices that power clean, affordable transport for riders and entrepreneurs across Africa, with AI tools like Claude Code alongside you. Because Mobility is scaling quickly, an entrepreneurial spirit will serve you well: you’ll enjoy building in a fast-growing business and taking real ownership.

The Impact – Africa’s transport sector is massive, underserved, and at an inflection point, and the shift to electric is accelerating, led by East Africa. Your code will directly power the technology behind Kenya’s leading e-mobility financing platform. M-KOPA has already served over 7 million customers and unlocked more than $2 billion in credit. jobs.title: Field Marketing Officer - Kisumu
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Field Marketing Officer in Kisumu to drive sales and market penetration for electric motorbikes. This is a field-based role where you'll be at the forefront of M-KOPA's E-Mobility revolution, executing sales strategies, generating and converting leads, and building strong relationships with customers and local communities.

''This role offers the opportunity to be part of a startup team within a larger company, bringing a new product division to life. You'll engage directly with customers through field visits, product demonstrations, and community events, while contributing valuable market insights that shape our go-to-market strategy.''

About Us

At M-KOPA, we're focused on digital and financial inclusion across Africa, serving over 3 million "everyday earners" through pay-as-you-go asset financing. Our Mobility division is expanding access to electric motorbikes, helping riders transition to cleaner, more cost-effective transportation solutions.

What You'll Do

  • Execute sales strategies and conduct field visits to promote and sell electric motorbikes

  • Generate and convert leads through field visits, customer referrals, partner networks, and community engagement

  • Provide product demonstrations and guide customers through the sales process

  • Build relationships with customers, local communities, leaders, and influencers

  • Support marketing campaigns by distributing materials and organizing local events

  • Collect market data, customer feedback, and competitor insights

  • Prepare regular reports on sales activities and conversion rates

  • Stay current on product features and industry trends related to electric motorbikes

This is an on-site role, you would be working from our field offices in Kisumu, partnering with a diverse group of employees from our different markets and locations across Kenya. You will be reporting to the Senior Commercial Manager.

Expertise

  • Diploma or Degree in Sales, Marketing, or related field

  • 2+ year of experience in sales, marketing, or related field

  • Experience in direct-to-consumer sales, preferably in the automotive industry

  • Proficiency with Excel and mobile sales tools

  • Proven track record of meeting and exceeding sales targets

If the above is of interest to you, please apply.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
We’re hiring someone to lead the people agenda for Kenya, our oldest and largest market, as it scales toward the next phase of the business.

Two things matter most. You’ve managed people partners before, not just worked alongside them. And you’ve held a market or business unit end to end, with the leadership relationship that comes with it.

This is a brand new role within the business, with huge impact and high visibility.

The Impact

Your work will directly shape how Kenya's leadership team builds, retains, and develops the people powering our largest market. We've recently celebrated reaching 10 million customers and are onboarding 10,000 new customers every day across all our markets. Behind every one of those numbers is a team of people, and you'll be the strategic partner ensuring that team is set up to keep scaling. It's your chance to be part of something that's literally transforming lives across an entire continent 🌍

What You’ll Do

  • Lead and develop the Kenya senior people partners who hold substantial books across Kenya sales, retail, manufacturing and logistics

  • Partner the Kenya MD and leadership team as their primary people counterpart, on structure, talent, culture and the hard conversations about leadership fit as the business scales

  • Own org design, talent review and succession for the market, and act as the escalation point for employee relations

  • Hold a focused client group of your own in business management, and customer care and collections

  • Translate group strategy into what actually happens in Kenya — real decisions, structure and delivery, not a cascade deck

  • Shape how we’re rebuilding job architecture, competencies and performance across the company — we’re open to doing this differently from the usual HR playbook

We want someone who thinks like a commercial and operational partner first — someone who can look past the standard HR approach when the business genuinely needs something else, and make that call with confidence.

What You Need

  • Real org design experience — whether built in-house or through consulting, you’ve designed structure and workforce plans, not just executed someone else’s

  • A business-first instinct — you reach for cost, risk, or growth before you reach for policy, and you can point to a time you made a call that wasn’t the textbook HR answer because the business needed something else

We are looking for a Sales Executive - ⁠Osogbo, Osun State to join our Sales Team as we scale up and drive digital and financial inclusion across our markets.

M-KOPA exists for the Every Day Earners of Africa, the people whose income keeps this continent moving, and who deserve a real shot at owning the assets that power it. We've now reached 10 million customers across Kenya, Uganda, Nigeria, Ghana, and South Africa, extending over $2 billion in credit to put phones, solar power, and e-mobility within reach. For 55% of our customers, we're the first formal financial service they've ever accessed. jobs.title: Procurement Lead - Mobility
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Procurement Lead to build and own M-KOPA Mobility’s procurement function from the ground up as we scale our operations across Kenya and into new markets.

 

''This is Mobility’s first dedicated Procurement Lead role, a rare opportunity to establish purchasing policy, build a vendor base, and negotiate the commercial terms that underpin everything from repair parts and retail stock to vehicle and battery purchasing from manufacturers. If you’re a seasoned procurement professional who thrives on building structure in fast-moving, cross-functional environments, this role is for you.''

About Us

M-KOPA’s Mobility division is transforming urban transport by making electric motorcycles accessible and affordable for everyday Kenyans. As we scale into new markets, we need a procurement function that keeps pace, one that brings commercial rigor, supplier discipline, and spend visibility to a business that is growing fast across multiple categories and geographies. You’ll work closely with Supply Chain, Business Operations, Product, Partnerships, Finance, and Legal to make that happen.

In this role, you would be responsible for:

  • Owning vendor contracting for parts, goods, and services. Negotiating terms directly for Mobility’s largest and most repeated purchases, and contracting and managing insurance, logistics, and freight partners

  • Maintaining a vendor register with pricing, terms, and performance history, and monitoring vendors on price, quality, and delivery, acting on underperformance where required

  • Setting purchasing policy and approval limits with the Head of Strategic Finance and applying them consistently across markets, flagging out-of-policy purchases for General Manager or Finance sign-off

  • Working with Supply Chain on specification and vendor selection for repair parts and inventory, with Business Operations on sourcing for retail and resale, and with Product and Partnerships on vehicle and battery purchasing from manufacturers bringing commercial terms, landed cost analysis, and supplier risk into every deal

  • Tracking and reporting Mobility’s spend by category and vendor, identifying savings opportunities and consolidation options

  • Running vendor onboarding and due diligence in line with M-KOPA policy, working with Legal and Compliance throughout

  • Standing up vendor relationships and purchasing terms ahead of each new market launch, working with Country Managers and Strategy on local sourcing options

This is a hybrid role based in Nairobi, Kenya, sitting within the Finance department of M-KOPA Mobility.

Your application should demonstrate:

  • 6+ years of experience in procurement or vendor management, ideally in a hardware, automotive, retail, or asset finance business

  • Proven experience negotiating contracts with parts, goods, insurance, or logistics vendors

  • Experience working across functions to translate a specification into a vendor decision

  • Experience setting purchasing policy that other teams apply day to day

  • Demonstrated ability to use spend data to drive savings and better vendor decisions

  • A degree in Business, Supply Chain, or a related field

If the above is of interest to you, please apply.

We are looking for a Field Sales Trainer to join our Sales Team; as we scale up and drive digital and financial inclusion across our markets.


The role

As Sales Trainer, you equip our sales force in your region with the tools, skills and knowledge to sell new and existing products well. You will raise the productivity of new DSRs, make sure newly recruited DSRs convert, and support sales activity across the region. You sit in the Sales department and report to the Regional Sales Training Lead.

About Us

M-KOPA is a pan-African fintech providing asset financing and credit to underserved customers. We have reached 10 million customers and extended $2B+ in credit. 86% of customers report a better quality of life, and 55% are accessing financial services for the first time. Our 2,300+ employees and 35,000+ field agents make it happen, and the Direct Sales Representatives (DSRs) you train are where every customer relationship begins.

This is a hybrid role, you would be working from our offices in Ghana, partnering with a diverse group of employees from our different markets and locations across the UK, Europe and Africa. You will be reporting to the Head of Sales.

What You'll Do

  • Own the conversion of every newly recruited DSR, measured by F7 (at least 1 sale within 7 days of registration), F30 (at least 8 sales within 30 days) and F60 (at least 8 sales in the next calendar month after F30).

  • Deliver regular in-class onboarding per territory each month, plus DSR career training and FSM/SE training as required. Teach proper onboarding and KYC fidelity so Quality of Sales reaches 95%.

  • Build the annual training calendar from needs surveys, assessments and feedback. Define clear outcomes with stakeholders, design training that can be applied the day after, and document your results.

  • Keep DSRs informed during outages such as system downtime, credits not updating or internet issues.

  • Reach at least 80% satisfaction and make sure every team is trained and ready to perform.

What You'll Need

  • At least a bachelor’s degree from a recognised university and at least 18 months as a Sales Trainer.

  • Strong command of Learning Management Systems, excellent presentation and MS PowerPoint skills, and solid business strategy, reporting, coaching and data analysis skills.

  • Self-motivation, a drive for results and a professional approach. You can train effectively in English and a local language, and Twi is an added advantage.



The honest part
This role is accountable. Your DSR conversion numbers are visible, the 95% Quality of Sales and 80% satisfaction targets are real, and outages will ask you to communicate clearly at short notice. jobs.title: Warehouse Assistant - Provisioning
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Warehouse Assistant to join our Warehouse team; as we scale up and drive digital and financial inclusion across our markets.


The role

As Warehouse Assistant, you receive and process incoming stock and materials, carry out stock counts, oversee provisioning officers and manage their SLAs, and resolve provisioning issues. The role sits in Warehouse & Logistics within Supply Chain, and the preferred candidate should be based in Asaba, Delta State.

About Us


M-KOPA is a pan-African fintech providing asset financing and credit services across Kenya, Uganda, Nigeria, Ghana and South Africa. We have reached 10 million customers, extended $2B+ in credit, and work with 2,300+ employees and 35,000+ field agents. 86% of our customers are satisfied, and 55% are accessing formal financial services for the first time.

This is a on-site role, you would be working from our offices in Nigeria, partnering with a diverse group of employees from our different markets and locations across the UK, Europe and Africa. You will be reporting to the Warehouse Lead.

What You'll Do

  • Receive OEM deliveries, verify them against the delivery note, and flag damage or shortages.

  • Label and store goods, update bin cards, and maintain FIFO on the floor.

  • Work with IT and the App testing team to run flashing tools (Odin/HMD Toolkit) and app installation (Cygwin) on all provisioning systems for device enrolment.

  • Support serial verification and keep provisioning desktops updated within the 24-hour firmware SLA.

  • Package devices (QSG, casing, screen protector, seal) and complete final QC checks.

  • Oversee provisioning officers, manage their SLAs, and resolve provisioning issues.

  • Produce daily, weekly and monthly throughput and stock count reports.

  • Report to the Warehouse Lead and jointly verify materials with Handlers.

  • Hit the standards: a 24-hour firmware update SLA, 300 devices per operator per day, and zero hand-over discrepancy.

What You'll Need

  • A Diploma in Store/Warehouse Management or Procurement

  • 2 years’ work experience in a similar position

  • Hands-on experience with an inventory management system, and working knowledge of Microsoft Office tools

  • Strong stock management, problem solving, time management and multitasking skills, along with the conflict management, negotiation and collaboration needed to keep a busy floor working together.

The honest part

This role is demanding. The SLAs are tight, the daily targets are real, and there is little room for error between a delivery note and a customer’s device. You will be managing people and pressure at the same time. If you take pride in getting the count right every time, you are probably ready for exactly this.

jobs.title: Customer Performance Field Officer - Mombasa
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Customer Performance Field Officer to drive timely loan repayments and recover overdue accounts and financed assets within an assigned territory across Kenya.

''This is a field-based role where up to 80% of your time will be spent in the field; combining in-person customer visits with telephone follow-up to locate customers, negotiate repayment, and where necessary, lawfully recover financed assets. If you’re a self-driven, compliance-minded field professional with collections or debt recovery experience and a valid motorcycle licence, this role is for you.''

About Us

M-KOPA’s Mobility division is transforming urban transport by making electric motorcycles accessible and affordable for everyday Kenyans. Our Customer Performance team is on the ground every day, protecting portfolio health, keeping customers on track with repayments, and ensuring financed assets are accounted for. You’ll work within an assigned territory, supported by a Customer Performance Field Team Lead and a broader operations team.

In this role, you would be responsible for:

  • Monitoring assigned accounts and taking appropriate action to keep the collection portfolio within accepted limits, applying sound credit judgment in line with policy guidelines

  • Contacting and locating customers to implement repayment schedules, educating them on the importance of timely repayment and the consequences of non-payment

  • Assisting customers with issues that may be affecting their ability to repay, including accidents, insurance claims, and other matters... and maintaining accurate records of all conversations and repayment status in M-KOPAnet, Freshdesk, and other relevant systems

  • Tracking and managing non-performing accounts, recommending and executing returns or repossessions in line with policy guidelines, and maintaining clean documentation of all returns, repossessions, and cancellations

  • Planning and executing field visits to recover payments or assets within the assigned territory, prioritising high-value collections leads and coordinating with local authorities and community leaders where required

  • Conducting all recoveries lawfully and peacefully — never using, threatening, or implying force, and immediately disengaging if a situation becomes hostile or unsafe

  • Repossessing financed assets only where properly authorised in the system and in line with the loan agreement and M-KOPA repossession policy, confirming the correct customer, account, and asset before taking any action

  • Handing over recovered assets and funds to the designated custodian within the same working day, and never storing recovered assets at a personal residence

  • Riding the assigned motorbike safely, lawfully, and in full compliance with Kenyan road-traffic requirements and M-KOPA policy at all times — including wearing PPE, maintaining roadworthiness checks, and reporting any accidents or incidents immediately

  • Providing daily and weekly updates on collections and recovery efforts, using data and tracking systems to monitor portfolio performance and recommend improvements

This is a field-based role operating within Nairobi and/or Mombasa in Kenya, with travel required up to 80% of the time. You will be reporting to the Customer Performance Field Team Lead.

Your application should demonstrate:

  • A valid NTSA driving license with motorcycle entitlement (Class A2): this is a mandatory requirement; applications without it will not be considered

  • Proven, competent motorbike riding experience and physical fitness to ride daily in varied terrain and weather conditions

  • Proven experience in collections, debt recovery, fleet management, or a similar field-based customer role

  • Strong communication skills; especially in handling difficult or sensitive customer interactions

  • Ability to manage field operations independently, including lawful asset recovery and professional interaction with customers, community leaders, and law enforcement

  • Proficiency with data tracking and reporting tools such as Excel and Freshdesk

  • A clean driving and conduct record, with the ability to pass background, integrity, and police-clearance checks

  • Tertiary education (College, TVET, University etc) in a relevant field is required

  • Familiarity with motorbike financing, e-mobility, or ride-hailing fleet operations is an added advantage.

Please read carefully before applying.

This is a high-risk, field-based role involving extensive daily motorbike riding in varied terrain and weather conditions, lone working in occasionally unfamiliar locations, handling of customer cash and financed assets, and direct engagement with law enforcement authorities. M-KOPA will provide safety equipment, training, insurance cover, and operating procedures. Disciplined adherence to safety, compliance, and integrity requirements is a core and non-negotiable part of the job.

If the above is of interest to you, please apply.

Why M-KOPA?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Field Sales Manager to lead the recruitment and management of Direct Sales Representatives (DSRs), drive sales quota attainment, and expand sales channels across an assigned geographical location in Uganda.

This role offers the opportunity to own your territory—building a high-performing field sales team that delivers results, upholds brand values, and drives financial inclusion across Uganda. You’ll recruit, coach, and develop DSRs, execute end-to-end sales programs, manage inventory, and grow local networks that expand M-KOPA’s market presence. You’ll be the bridge between business strategy and field execution—the leader who ensures every DSR understands the direction, embraces the change, and delivers the numbers.

About Us

We foster a culture where sales leadership meets business ownership. Our team values data-driven decision-making, disciplined execution, and leadership that develops people while delivering results. You’ll be empowered to design sales strategies, build local networks, and drive customer credit performance that directly contributes to profitability and business growth across your assigned territory.

At M-KOPA, our Field Sales Managers aren’t just team supervisors—they’re territory owners who build sales capability from the ground up, protect brand integrity in the field, and create the customer relationships that keep millions of Ugandans connected to life-changing products.

In this role, you would be responsible for:

Team Building & People Development

  • Recruiting, coaching, mentoring, and establishing a robust sales and customer-centric skill set for Direct Sales Representatives

  • Being a change catalyst—ensuring any change in business focus is embraced and adhered to by the team rather than met with resistance

  • Building a motivated, accountable field sales team with a collective winning mentality

  • Cascading business direction seamlessly and effortlessly to the direct sales channel

Sales Execution & Territory Management

  • Overseeing the overall implementation of sales programs and end-to-end execution of sales activities in sync with business direction within assigned territory

  • Designing sales and marketing strategies for the team to ensure weekly, monthly, and quarterly sales targets are reached and exceeded

  • Actively seeking out sales opportunities in assigned geographical locations through lead generation, excellent pitching, customer profiling, and exceptional after-sales calls

  • Developing local networks to assist in growing sales volumes and expanding market presence

Inventory & Stock Management

  • Managing inventory with a methodical and systematic approach for assigned depot/location

  • Ensuring stock accountability and proper controls across the field sales operation

  • Maintaining healthy inventory discipline across all DSRs in the territory

Credit Performance & Business Profitability

  • Aligning sales goals and processes to build solid customer credit performance

  • Being fully engrossed in keeping a healthy credit standing in the assigned area of operation

  • Maximizing profitability through disciplined sales processes and customer screening

  • Driving customer satisfaction and business profitability through the direct sales representative channel

Market Intelligence & Reporting

  • Staying abreast of competitor intelligence, customer insights, and market trends—promptly sharing with internal teams

  • Interpreting reports seamlessly and populating weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual business-centric reports

  • Preparing and submitting weekly activity plans and reports to the Regional Sales Manager

  • Using data to identify opportunities, address gaps, and continuously sharpen field sales performance

Brand & Values Leadership

  • Pioneering and upholding M-KOPA brand values at all times in the field

  • Ensuring all DSR activities reflect M-KOPA’s commitment to customer-first selling and ethical business practices

  • Maintaining professionalism and integrity standards across the entire field team

This is a field-based leadership role (Job Band D2) located in Uganda, within the Sales department. If successful, you would be reporting to the Regional Sales Manager.

Your application should demonstrate:

Experience & Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Management or any other relevant field

  • 3+ years of sales experience with a proven track record of leadership

  • Experience managing field sales teams and DSR networks

  • Track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets in a field environment

Skills & Competencies

  • Excellent sales and negotiation skills with strong pitching and closing ability

  • Ability to motivate and lead a team toward collective goals

  • Excellent communication and people skills—you cascade direction clearly and inspire action

  • Good planning and organizational skills with ability to manage territory operations systematically

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with urgency and composure under pressure

  • Data-driven mindset—you interpret reports, spot trends, and make decisions based on evidence

  • Proficiency in MS Office tools for reporting and planning

  • Change catalyst ability—you bring teams with you through change rather than fighting resistance

Core Competencies

  • Business Acumen: You understand how field sales activity connects to revenue, credit performance, and profitability

  • Conflict Management: You resolve team and customer issues with professionalism and fairness

  • Collaborative Skills: You work effectively with internal teams and DSRs for collective success

  • Professionalism & Ethics: You uphold high integrity standards in every interaction

  • Self-Management: You take ownership of your territory and results without needing to be micromanaged

If the above is of interest to you, please apply.

jobs.title: Customer Operations Officer - Insurance
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are looking for an Insurance Customer Operations Officer to coordinate insurance coverage, manage end-to-end claims resolution, and support rider income protection as we continue to scale our Mobility division across Kenya.

''This role sits at the heart of our insurance and claims operations — ensuring every eligible rider has timely, compliant coverage, and that when incidents happen, claims move quickly, accurately, and with a positive customer experience throughout. If you’re a detail-oriented operations professional with experience in insurance or claims coordination and a strong service mindset, this role is for you.''

About Us

M-KOPA’s Mobility division is transforming urban transport by making electric motorcycles accessible and affordable for everyday Kenyans. Our insurance operations function is critical to protecting riders’ livelihoods and M-KOPA’s assets; from coordinating policy issuance and renewals to managing the full claims lifecycle across insurers, garages, hospitals, and customers. You’ll work in a fast-paced, process-driven environment where accuracy, proactivity, and stakeholder coordination make a real difference.

In this role, you would be responsible for:

  • Coordinating insurance issuance — including sticker generation and DMVIC documentation — and proactively managing policy renewals and customer notifications to prevent coverage lapses

  • Managing the complete claims lifecycle from incident reporting and documentation through insurer submission, assessment, authorization, repair or compensation processing, and final claim closure

  • Liaising with insurers, approved garages, hospitals, customers, and internal teams to facilitate timely claims processing, resolve bottlenecks, and maintain clear communication throughout the claims journey

  • Processing bed-rest compensation and medical payments accurately and within agreed turnaround times to ensure eligible riders receive timely income protection support

  • Coordinating the issuance, tracking, and return of loaner bikes in collaboration with the Inventory team, maintaining clear communication with customers throughout the loaner period

  • Maintaining accurate, complete, and up-to-date insurance and claims records across all tracking systems, ensuring all accident incidents are promptly recorded with complete supporting documentation

  • Submitting claims to insurers within agreed SLA timelines, monitoring progress against turnaround targets, and proactively following up on outstanding actions to minimize delays

  • Conducting regular customer follow-up calls to obtain outstanding documentation, provide claims status updates, and guide customers through the claims and compensation process

  • Coordinating with approved garages to monitor repair progress, turnaround times, quality standards, and customer communication

  • Identifying and escalating complex claims, SLA breaches, and high-impact cases to the Customer Operations Team Lead with relevant background and recommended solutions

  • Preparing and submitting accurate weekly reports on claims volumes, submissions, approvals, closures, outstanding claims, ageing, turnaround times, and SLA compliance

  • Working closely with Customer Operations, Inventory, Finance, and Sales teams to coordinate interdependent activities and ensure seamless service delivery

  • Identifying recurring claims bottlenecks and process inefficiencies and recommending practical improvements to strengthen operational controls and enhance customer experience

This is an on-site role based in Nairobi, Kenya. You will be reporting to the Customer Operations Team Lead.

Your application should demonstrate:

  • Experience in insurance operations, claims coordination, or a related customer operations role

  • Strong attention to detail — able to maintain accurate records and manage documentation across multiple active cases simultaneously

  • Experience liaising with external stakeholders such as insurers, garages, or hospitals is a strong advantage

  • Proficiency in Excel and data tracking tools, with the ability to generate and analyse weekly performance reports

  • Strong communication and follow-up skills — comfortable engaging customers, internal teams, and external partners proactively

  • Ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously without dropping quality or missing SLA deadlines

If the above is of interest to you, please apply.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Credit and Analytics
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Senior Manager, Credit and Analytics (Nairobi, Kenya)

When did a credit decision last change someone's income?

You're accomplished. You're respected. You're probably even happy. You can read a portfolio, spot the first wobble in a vintage, and explain it to a room that would rather hear good news.

So here is a different question. What if the book you owned was the engine of financial inclusion for millions of people no formal lender had ever served? What if a pricing call or a collections insight showed up, within weeks, in whether a family kept its phone, its solar light or its livelihood?

Ten million customers, and the credit book behind them

M-KOPA has unlocked more than $2 billion in credit for 10 million customers across Sub-Saharan Africa, up from 5 million a year earlier. 86% report an improved quality of life, 70% use what they finance to earn an income, and 55% are accessing formal financial products and services for the first time. Behind that sit 2,300+ employees and 35,000 agents, plus $45 million contributed in taxes. In Kenya we have assembled 2 million smartphones locally. None of it holds together unless credit performs.

Why this timing matters

If you've noticed us hiring across several functions, that is deliberate. We are moving from 5 million customers to 7 million, and building toward 10 million. A book that size cannot be run on the instincts and spreadsheets that got us here. We are putting the analytical and BI foundations in place before the next phase of growth demands them, and this role is where growth and portfolio quality are kept pulling in the same direction.

What makes this different

In most credit roles you own a slice: a model, a report, a policy. Here you own the outcome. Kenyan credit performance is the measure of your success, and you hold the levers that move it: the analytics that diagnose deterioration, the pricing that decides who we can serve and at what margin, and the BI that tells the business the truth.

Your current role: you advise, and others decide. This role: you recommend directly to the Managing Director, the General Manager and the Kenya Leadership Team, and what you recommend changes what we do next. You'll also see the customer behind the number, with regular field visits to the places where these loans are actually repaid.

What you'll bring

  • A seasoned, demonstrable record in credit risk and portfolio performance within financial services, ideally in consumer lending or PAYGO in emerging markets, with a clear grasp of how credit outcomes connect to pricing, unit economics and margin.

  • Top-tier analytical capability: building models and insights from multi-source data with code-based tools and BI platforms, designing experiments, and turning the results into recommendations senior leaders act on.

  • AI mastery: Demonstrable ability to use AI tools effectively within real business workflows, going beyond occasional use to craft effective prompts, critically validate outputs, integrate AI into analytical and decision-making processes, and continuously refine approaches to deliver consistently better results.

  • Proven experience leading BI or analytics delivery and directing analysts and managers, with the standing to influence decisions at General Manager and executive level.

A quantitative degree is preferred, and a postgraduate qualification or a designation such as CFA, ACCA, CPA or FRM is a welcome extra rather than a gate. Beyond the technical, you are someone who can bring Credit, Sales and Finance around a single outcome, who writes analysis an executive reads in full, and who coaches people to focus on results rather than output. Above all, you believe credit performance is the number that matters, and you're comfortable being measured on it.

What your weeks look like

  • Diagnosing and steering the portfolio. You run weekly, monthly and quarterly credit reporting, lead the portfolio review with fraud and collections inputs, and go deep when performance slips to find the cause and lead the response. You also represent credit on regulatory matters and lead credit bureau decisions.

  • Pricing for growth and margin. You price payment plans so sales can grow while credit stays healthy, test the credit assumptions behind new plans, and forecast how each initiative moves unit economics.

  • Building trusted data and a strong team. You own BI delivery for Kenya, set the standards for data quality and metric definitions, partner with data and engineering teams, and coach the team so the business gets numbers it can trust, on time.

The reality check

This role is demanding. Credit performance is your headline measure, so when a trend turns, you are the first person asked why and what happens next. You'll move from query-level detail to a leadership table in the same day, and you'll spend real time in the field. It rewards people who like owning a number. And you're probably ready for exactly this.

Let's talk

If you read this and thought "I wasn't looking, but this is different," that's probably the signal to have the conversation. No pressure, no pitch. Just a conversation about what owning credit for a business serving millions could look like

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.

Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at m-kopa.com.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Mobility
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Join our expanding Mobility engineering team! We’re actively recruiting a Senior Backend Engineer as M-KOPA Mobility, our fast-growing e-mobility business, which has a 3x year-on-year growth rate! Build the event-driven microservices that power clean, affordable transport for riders and entrepreneurs across Africa, with AI tools like Claude Code alongside you. Because Mobility is scaling quickly, an entrepreneurial spirit will serve you well: you’ll enjoy building in a fast-growing business and taking real ownership.

The Impact – Africa’s transport sector is massive, underserved, and at an inflection point, and the shift to electric is accelerating, led by East Africa. Your code will directly power the technology behind Kenya’s leading e-mobility financing platform. M-KOPA has already served over 7 million customers and unlocked more than $2 billion in credit. In Mobility, we’ve financed over 11,000 electric motorbikes, helping riders save more than $3 a day and cutting air pollution by 90%. It’s your chance to build tech for a business that’s literally transforming lives across an entire continent 🌍

The Opportunity

 

🚀 Scale challenges: M-KOPA Mobility is growing 3x year-on-year as its own fast-scaling business, with over 11,000 e-motorbikes financed and demand climbing. As it grows, so do the opportunities to expand your scope, your impact and your career

🎯 Mission-driven engineering: Every service you build helps put clean transport within reach of riders who’d otherwise be locked out of ownership

🏆 Global recognition: Join a company named by the Financial Times as one of Africa’s fastest-growing for 5 consecutive years (2022–2026)

🌱 Environmental impact: Electric is simply better for drivers, cities and the planet. Our e-motorbikes cut air pollution by 90% versus petrol equivalents

 

What You’ll Do

 

At M-KOPA, you’ll build sophisticated event-driven microservices with real-world impact. Our engineering teams own their solutions end-to-end, from architecture decisions to production monitoring, using AI coding tools like Claude Code to move faster along the way. Join us in combining cutting-edge .NET development with purpose-driven engineering that makes digital and financial inclusion possible across Africa.

 

Technical Environment 💻

 

  • Languages & frameworks: C#/.NET

  • Cloud: We work in Azure, and welcome experience across AWS or GCP

  • Architecture: Event-driven systems and microservice development. We use Service Bus, and welcome experience with similar messaging technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ

  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes, Docker

  • Observability: Prometheus, Grafana

  • Engineering culture: DevOps, infrastructure as code, automated testing across all environments including production, continuous delivery

  • AI tooling: We use AI coding tools, including Claude Code, as part of our engineering workflow

 

Our Engineering Approach 🚀

 

As an engineer, you’ll work as a collaborator. More senior members will coach and contribute, placing an emphasis on:

 

  • High quality output

  • Observability and monitoring

  • Automated testing in all environments, including production

  • Infrastructure as code and DevOps practices

  • AI-assisted development with tools like Claude Code

 

What You Need

 

We expect you to be comfortable working as part of a team that owns the entire software stack, including supporting infrastructure, throughout the software lifecycle, from inception through production to decommissioning, under a DevOps culture. You’ll value the constraints that continuous delivery places upon engineering processes and embrace testing and observability as first-order concerns in development.

 

Required Experience:

 

  • Strong grasp of C# .NET development

  • Experience with event-driven systems: Service Bus or similar messaging technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ

  • Microservices architecture experience

  • Experience with Azure, or other major cloud providers such as AWS or GCP

  • Familiarity with containerisation and orchestration tools (Kubernetes, Docker)

  • Experience with observability tools such as Prometheus and Grafana

  • Testing and deployment expertise

  • DevOps culture mindset

  • Experience working with AI coding tools, ideally Claude Code or similar

Location & Benefits

  • Permanent role - Benefits Package include Bonus, Growth Shares & On-Call allowance

  • Fully remote role within UTC -1 to UTC +3 time zones

  • Work with diverse teams across UK, Europe, and Africa

  • Professional development programs and coaching partnerships

  • Family-friendly policies and flexible working arrangements

  • Well-being support and career growth opportunities

Our Mission 🌍 We create financial inclusion for the traditionally excluded through a fair, flexible, customer-centric financing model, with M-KOPA Mobility extending that same model to clean transport. We strive to drive greater inclusion of women, youth, and low-income communities.

Our Impact 💚

  • Connected 📱: 6 million smartphone customers, 2.5 million first-time smartphone users

  • Prosperous 💰: 70% of customers use their M-KOPA product for income generation, with 35,000+ livelihoods created for agents

  • Green 🌱: 11,000+ e-motorbikes financed, growing 3x year-on-year, cutting air pollution by 90% and helping riders save more than $3 a day

Ready to build C# .NET solutions that put clean, affordable transport within reach of Every Day Earners, while advancing your career in modern, AI-powered backend engineering?

 

Apply now to join our mission of transforming lives across Africa through technology.

Why M-KOPA?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.

Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at m-kopa.com.

Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026), named on CNBC's World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025 & 2026 and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 10 million customers, unlocking $2 billion in cumulative credit for the everyday earners across Africa, in addition to over 10,000 e-bikes financed in Kenya.

Important Notice

M-KOPA is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to assembling a diverse, broadly trained staff. Women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.

M-KOPA explicitly prohibits the use of Forced or Child Labour and respects the rights of its employees to agree to terms and conditions of employment voluntarily, without coercion, and freely terminate their employment on appropriate notice. M-KOPA shall ensure that its Employees are of legal working age and shall comply with local laws for youth employment or student work, such as internships or apprenticeships. 

M-KOPA does not collect/charge any money as a pre-employment or post-employment requirement. This means that we never ask for ‘recruitment fees’, ‘processing fees’, ‘interview fees’, or any other kind of money in exchange for offer letters or interviews at any time during the hiring process.

Applications for this position will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisting and interviews will take place at any stage during the recruitment process. We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if a suitable candidate is selected before the advertised closing date.

If your application is successful M-KOPA undertakes pre-employment background checks as part of its recruitment process, these include; criminal records, identification verification, academic qualifications, employment dates and employer references.
