jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Asset Sales
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Join our expanding engineering team!

We're hiring a permanent Senior Backend Engineer to join our Asset Sales group as we scale one of the most important parts of M-KOPA's FinTech platform. Build distributed, event-driven microservices and help shape what AI-native engineering looks like at M-KOPA.

The Impact 💚

Your code will directly power the systems that put smartphones and e-motorbikes into the hands of Every Day Earners across Africa. We've already helped over 10 million customers access more than $2 billion in credit. It's your chance to be part of something that's literally transforming lives across an entire continent 🌍

The Opportunity

🎯 Mission-driven engineering: Every service you build helps expand financial inclusion for under-banked populations

🏆 Global recognition: Join a company named by the Financial Times as one of Africa's fastest-growing companies for five consecutive years (2022–2026)

🚀 Scale challenges: Build backend systems serving millions across multiple African markets

🤖 AI-native from day one: We're actively embracing AI as part of the engineering craft, not bolting it on

🌍 Fully distributed: Work remotely with diverse teams across UK, Europe, and Africa

What You'll Do

At M-KOPA, you'll build and operate distributed C# and .NET microservices on Azure, working within an event-driven architecture at significant scale. This is an outcomes-driven role: we care far more about the value you create than where you sit or how many hours you're online. You'll own what you build end-to-end — from idea, through implementation and deployment, into production and iteration.

Technical Environment 💻

  • Modern C# stack: Distributed C# and .NET microservices

  • Cloud & orchestration: Hosted on Azure using Kubernetes

  • Architecture: Event-driven, supporting products used at significant scale

  • Observability: Grafana, Azure Application Insights, logs, traces, and metrics

  • AI tooling: Claude and other AI tools used throughout the engineering workflow — design exploration, code generation and review, test writing, incident investigation, and technical communication

Our Engineering Approach 🚀

  • AI-native engineering: We want engineers who tinker — experimenting with new tools, agents, and workflows, and sharing what works

  • Guardrails as we accelerate: Automated tests, SLOs, alerting, observability, and deployment safeguards around everything we ship

  • Own it beyond the pull request: Design for idempotency, retries, out-of-order events, and failure modes, and know how your services behave in production

  • The Campfire Rule: Leave the systems you touch a little better than you found them

  • On-call as feedback, not heroics: Engineers who build our systems also help operate them, using incidents to make the platform more resilient

What You Need

We're looking for a senior engineer who's curious, autonomous, and highly trusted. You're comfortable owning the entire software stack — including supporting infrastructure — throughout its lifecycle, and you see production data, not just deployment, as the real measure of "done."

Required Experience:

  • Strong grasp of C# and .NET development

  • Experience with event-driven systems - We use Azure Service Bus, but would love to hear from you if you have experience with similar messaging technology (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.)

  • Microservices architecture experience, ideally on Azure and Kubernetes

  • Experience using observability tooling (e.g. Grafana, Application Insights) to understand production behaviour

  • Comfort using AI tools as part of a daily engineering workflow (design, code review, testing, incident investigation)

  • DevOps culture mindset, including on-call/production ownership

  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively in distributed teams across time zones

  • Continuous learning mindset and openness to feedback

Location & Benefits

  • Fully remote role, collaborating during core GMT working hours

  • Benefits package, which includes Bonus, Growth Shares & On-Call Allowance

  • Work with diverse teams distributed across UK, Europe, and Africa

  • Personalised training budget to support your development

  • Home office setup budget

  • Professional development programs and coaching partnerships

  • Family-friendly policies and flexible working arrangements

  • Well-being support and career growth opportunities

Our Mission 🌍

We create financial inclusion for the traditionally excluded through a fair, flexible, customer-centric financing model. We strive to drive greater inclusion of women, youth, and low-income communities.

Our Impact 💚

Our technology has created measurable change:

  • Connected 📱: 2.5 million first-time smartphone users connected

  • Prosperous 💰: 70% of customers use M-KOPA products for income generation, with 35,000 livelihoods created for agents

  • Green 🌱: 2.155 million tonnes of CO₂ avoided since 2010 through clean energy, refurbished devices, and e-mobility

Ready to build C#/.NET systems — with AI as part of your craft — that create real-world financial inclusion? Apply Now!

Why M-KOPA?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.

Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at m-kopa.com.

Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026), named on CNBC's World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025 & 2026 and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 10 million customers, unlocking $2 billion in cumulative credit for the everyday earners across Africa, in addition to over 10,000 e-bikes financed in Kenya.

M-KOPA shall ensure that its Employees are of legal working age and shall comply with local laws for youth employment or student work, such as internships or apprenticeships. 

M-KOPA does not collect/charge any money as a pre-employment or post-employment requirement. This means that we never ask for ‘recruitment fees’, ‘processing fees’, ‘interview fees’, or any other kind of money in exchange for offer letters or interviews at any time during the hiring process.

Applications for this position will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisting and interviews will take place at any stage during the recruitment process. We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if a suitable candidate is selected before the advertised closing date.

jobs.title: Sales Executive, Indirect Channel - Accra
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Sales Executive in Accra to join our Sales Team - Indirect Channel as we scale up and drive digital and financial inclusion across our markets.


The Role

Grow and manage the Indirect Channel in your territory, covering dealer shops and community shops. You will report to the Regional Sales Manager and deliver weekly, monthly and quarterly targets while upholding M-KOPA’s brand and retail standards in every shop, including no unofficial customer fees.


About Us

M-KOPA is a pan-African fintech providing asset financing and credit services across Kenya, Uganda, Nigeria, Ghana and South Africa. We serve 10 million customers and have extended over $2 billion in credit, giving people access to products they could not previously finance.

This is a on-site role, you would be working from our offices in Ghana, partnering with a diverse group of employees from our different markets and locations across the UK, Europe and Africa. You will be reporting to the Regional Sales Manager.


What You'll Do

  • Lead and coach Cluster Leaders, holding them accountable for cluster results, and work through them to recruit, train and supervise DSRs

  • Recruit and onboard dealer and community shops, and follow each one until its first sale

  • Focus coaching on high-potential and slipping shops, and agree recovery plans or recommend exit for inactive ones

  • Build strong relationships with key shop owners and retain our best partners against competitor offers

  • Design the sales and marketing plan for your territory, including local promotions

  • Enforce KYC, duplicate-ID checks and fee rules, and review early repayment signals with Credit and Collections

  • Manage DSR inventory, resolve audit recommendations, and report weekly on shop and team performance.

What You'll Need

  • A first degree or Higher National Diploma

  • At least 3 years of sales experience in Ghana in microfinance, insurance, telecommunications, mobile money, FMCG or similar products or services

  • Proven experience leading a multi-level field team, including supervisors or team leaders, and distribution partners such as retailers, agents or dealers

  • Excellent sales, negotiation, presentation and communication skills, with the ability to motivate, coach and lead a wide range of people

  • Comfort using data and mobile apps to track performance and report

The honest part

This role has real targets every week, month and quarter, and you will be expected to stay calm under pressure. You will manage attrition, resolve conflict between team members, shops and agents, and travel regularly across your territory. Our standard on compliance is zero substantiated fee complaints. If you want growth that is built to last, this is the job.

jobs.title: Sales Executive - Amasaman
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Sales Executive to join our Sales Team, as we scale up and drive digital and financial inclusion across our markets.


This isn't a territory management job dressed up in mission language. As a Sales Executive at M-KOPA Ghana, you'll be the engine behind a field team of Direct Sales Representatives - recruiting them, training them, coaching them, and driving them toward targets that actually mean something. The customers your team reaches aren't switching providers for a better deal. For many of them, this is the first time anyone has offered them credit at all.

We're in active expansion mode, moving from 7 million toward 10 million customers. The infrastructure being built right now, the teams, the networks, the local market strategies will define how fast we get there. You'd be joining at exactly the moment when what you build has the most to shape.


About Us

M-KOPA has grown to 10 million customers across Kenya, Uganda, Nigeria, Ghana, and South Africa, extending over $2 billion in credit to people building better lives one asset at a time. 86% of our customers report improved satisfaction, and 55% are accessing formal financial services for the first time through us. Behind that scale sits a network of over 35,000 field agents and 2,300+ employees, all working toward one goal: helping Every Day Earners own more, faster.

This is an on-site role, you would be working from our offices in Ghana, partnering with a diverse group of employees from our different markets and locations across the UK, Europe and Africa. You will be reporting to the Regional Manager.

What You'll Do

  • Recruit, train, coach and supervise a field-based team of Direct Sales Representatives, monitoring their performance consistently against M-KOPA's standards while managing DSR inventory and resolving audit recommendations in line with company guidelines.

  • Design and execute the sales and marketing strategy for your territory, setting the direction for weekly, monthly, and quarterly target achievement while monitoring and analyzing the performance of marketing campaigns.

  • Deliver and exceed sales targets across your designated territory by developing strong local networks that uphold M-KOPA's brand values and retail point standards.

What you'll bring

  • Demonstrable experience in sales within microfinance, insurance, telecommunications, mobile money, FMCG, or related sectors in Ghana, with a proven track record of hitting and exceeding targets.

  • Established expertise in recruiting, coaching, and leading field-based sales teams; you know how to get performance from people, not just compliance.

  • Proven ability to design and execute territory-level sales and marketing strategies that translate into consistent weekly, monthly, and quarterly results.

The honest part

This role operates in the field, across communities that aren't always easy to reach. The targets are real, the accountability is direct, and the pace reflects a business that's scaling fast. jobs.title: Head of Finance:  M-KOPA Mobility
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Head of Finance, M-KOPA Mobility

Join M-KOPA Mobility, our fast-growing e-mobility business, as we scale clean, affordable transport across Africa. Mobility is growing rapidly, with over 11,000 electric motorbikes financed and 3x year-on-year growth. We’re now looking for a commercially minded Head of Finance to help shape how the business funds, plans and delivers its next phase of growth.

This is not a traditional finance leadership role. You’ll sit at the heart of the Mobility business, working closely with the Managing Director and Mobility Leadership Team to turn capital into growth, translate business performance into clear decisions, and build the financial foundations needed to scale.

If you enjoy operating in a fast-growing, early-stage environment where finance is a strategic partner to the business — rather than a function sitting on the sidelines — this could be the opportunity for you.

The Impact 🌍

Africa’s transport sector is massive, underserved and undergoing a significant shift towards electric mobility. M-KOPA Mobility is helping make clean transport more accessible to riders and entrepreneurs through flexible financing.

With over 11,000 e-motorbikes financed, Mobility is already making a measurable difference — helping riders save more than $3 a day and cutting air pollution by 90% compared with petrol equivalents.

As Mobility continues to grow, finance will play a critical role in ensuring the business has the capital, insight and financial discipline to scale sustainably.

That’s where you come in.

The Opportunity 🚀

As Head of Finance, you’ll be responsible for making sure M-KOPA Mobility is financially resourced to grow, that capital is deployed efficiently, and that leadership and investors have a clear view of business performance they can trust and act on.

You’ll have the opportunity to:

🎯 Shape capital strategy: Partner with the Managing Director on Mobility’s capital strategy, including funding sources, capital structure and the sequencing of future raises. You’ll own the Mobility financial model and lead the finance work supporting fundraising and investor due diligence.

📊 Own performance and reporting: Give leadership a clear view of how the business is performing, what is driving results and where action is needed. You’ll lead business performance reviews and oversee the financial content of leadership and board reporting.

💡 Drive financial planning: Own Mobility’s annual business plan, budget and financial targets, while building the reporting and insight needed to support better commercial decisions around pricing, retention economics and new market investment.

💰 Lead treasury execution: Work across Mobility and Group Finance to forecast cash and funding requirements and ensure funding and payment execution supports the pace of growth.

🤝 Enable growth through procurement: Lead the Mobility procurement team, balancing speed and cost-efficiency with the governance and controls required within the wider M-KOPA Group.

 

Your Role in Mobility

This is a central role serving the Mobility business and you'll be a member of the Mobility Leadership Team.

You’ll be the first point of contact for Finance matters raised by the Managing Director, General Manager and Head of Portfolio, bringing financial insight into the decisions that shape the business.

You’ll also work closely with Group Finance, leveraging the Group’s accounting backbone while ensuring Mobility’s financial reporting, controls and records meet Group policies and Big 4 audit standards.

In short: you’ll help build the financial engine that allows Mobility to scale.

What You’ll Bring 💼

We’re looking for a senior finance leader who is comfortable combining strategic thinking with hands-on execution in a fast-moving environment.

You’ll ideally bring:

  • 10+ years of finance experience, including senior leadership experience in a fast-growing, capital-intensive or lending business

  • Experience raising debt or equity, from financial modelling and investor materials through due diligence to close

  • Strong experience owning a business plan, budget and financial targets, and holding the business accountable to them

  • Experience leading financial reporting within a multi-entity or group environment, with strong governance and audit standards

  • Experience working with credit or risk teams to connect portfolio performance, priced risk and financial reporting

  • Experience leading teams and operating as a senior business partner, influencing decisions beyond Finance

We’re particularly interested in people who can move comfortably between the detail and the bigger picture — someone who can interrogate the numbers, challenge assumptions, communicate with investors and leadership, and translate financial insight into commercial action.

Why M-KOPA? 🌍

At M-KOPA, we’re building solutions that expand financial and economic opportunity for people who have traditionally been underserved.

Mobility takes that same model into clean transport — helping riders access affordable electric motorbikes that can support their livelihoods while contributing to cleaner cities.

As part of M-KOPA, you’ll have the opportunity to work in a purpose-driven, fast-growing business while having real influence over how one of its newest businesses scales.

You’ll also be part of a diverse, international organisation with opportunities for development, coaching, flexibility and career growth.

Ready to shape the financial future of M-KOPA Mobility?

If you're a strategic finance leader who wants to play a meaningful role in scaling a high-growth e-mobility business across Africa, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now and join us in transforming how Africa moves.

Why M-KOPA?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.

Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at m-kopa.com.

M-KOPA shall ensure that its Employees are of legal working age and shall comply with local laws for youth employment or student work, such as internships or apprenticeships.

jobs.title: Senior Sales Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
You’ve proven you can hit your numbers. Now lead the sales engine that connects millions of Kenyans to life-changing products.

You’re accomplished and respected, and you’re probably happy where you are. But are you energised?

M-KOPA now serves 7 million customers (up from 5 million in 2024) and has unlocked over $2 billion in credit. 86% of customers report improved quality of life, and 55% are accessing a product or service for the first time. With 2,300+ employees and 35,000 agents, we’re building the leadership structure for the move to 10 million customers. Kenya’s field sales organisation is where that growth is won.

What makes this different

Most senior sales roles offer strategy or execution. This one demands both. You’ll represent field priorities in senior leadership forums, then visit clusters and coach Regional Managers on the ground. You’ll own budgets and build people. You’ll drive conversion while protecting repayment performance.

About Us

We foster a culture where commercial leadership meets field accountability. Our team values data-driven decision-making, strong people development, and sales execution that doesn’t compromise customer outcomes. You’ll be empowered to make timely performance decisions, design territory strategies, and drive improvements that directly impact revenue, DSR productivity, and customer satisfaction across M-KOPA Kenya’s most critical growth function.

At M-KOPA, our Senior Commercial Manager isn’t just a sales director—they’re the commercial architect who builds regional leaders, protects sales quality, and creates the field execution engine that connects millions of Kenyan customers to life-changing products.

What you’ll do

  • Lead four regions. Translate strategy into regional plans, develop Regional Managers, and make fair, timely decisions on performance, promotions, and exits, using scorecards, coaching, and field visits to keep execution consistent.

jobs.title: Senior CRM Manager - Conversion & Lifecycle
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Join our expanding Product Growth team! We’re actively recruiting a Senior CRM Manager as we continue to scale at M-KOPA. Most senior growth hires get one channel and one pod for years. This role is built differently: you’ll own two of our core growth pods in your first year, then land where you’ve had the most impact. It’s a fast track to pod leadership, not a support seat.

The Impact 💚

You’ll drive the conversion growth that turns customers into long-term, high-value ones, creating financial inclusion for Africa’s traditionally excluded. We’ve already helped over 10 million customers access over $2 billion in credit 🌍

The Opportunity

🏗️ Real ownership from day one. You'll be the one accountable for delivery in Repeat Phones, not shadowing or supporting someone else's plan.

🎒 Two growth motions, one year. You'll take on Digital Lending mid-way through, working directly with one of our strongest performers to understand cash loans end to end, then carry that pod solo for a defined stretch. Few people get this breadth this early.

🧭 A defined path, not indefinite floating. You'll build real expertise in our two conversion pods first, then move into Lifecycle in the second half of next year, reporting to the Lifecycle CRM Lead once you're there. The destination is set. What you bring to it is up to you. 🌍 Work inside a proven CLV engine. M-KOPA has helped more than 10 million customers access over $2 billion in credit. You'll be executing inside systems that already work, not guessing at what might.

What You'll Do

Phase 1: Repeat Phones. Take ownership of reactivation and upgrade campaigns in CleverTap, working closely with the Growth Lead there to understand what's driving the pod's numbers and where the next opportunity is. You'll be trusted to make real calls here, not just execute a checklist.

Phase 2: Cross into Digital Lending. Work directly with the Digital Lending lead, one of our top performers, to understand cash loan growth end to end before taking it on yourself.

Phase 3: Own Digital Lending. Carry primary responsibility for Digital Lending for a defined period, with the Repeat Phones lead available if you need a second opinion.

Phase 4: Move into Lifecycle. In the second half of next year, join the Lifecycle pod full-time, reporting to the Lifecycle CRM Lead. You'll bring a year of hands-on conversion experience into a pod that's still being built, real currency for shaping what Lifecycle does next. Throughout all phases, you will:

  • Build and run multi-channel campaigns (SMS, WhatsApp, push, in-app) in CleverTap against pod goals

  • Track funnel performance and flag drop-off points to the pod lead you're supporting

  • Run structured experiments (creative, audience, incentive, or timing) with clear hypotheses

  • Turn what works into documented playbooks the next person can pick up

  • Keep data quality and campaign tracking clean enough that leadership can trust the numbers

Key Metrics You'll Influence

Repeat Phones: Reactivation rate, upgrade conversion %, unit economics per sale

Digital Lending: Approval → disbursement rate, digital loan volume, approval quality

Campaign ROI and payback period across both

Your Environment

💼 Tech Stack: CleverTap (primary), Looker Channels: WhatsApp, SMS, push, in-app messaging

Markets: Kenya, Nigeria, Uganda, Ghana

What You Need

  • 5+ years in growth, performance, or lifecycle marketing, ideally in fintech, telco, or e-commerce, with real ownership over what a campaign or a pod achieved, not just involvement in it.

  • Judgment as much as skill. You can walk into a pod, understand what's working and why, and make calls on where to push, not just follow a brief.

  • Genuine appetite for pod leadership. This is a deliberate path toward owning a pod outright, and the breadth here is designed to get you there faster than a single-channel role would.

  • Hands-on fluency in CRM platforms like CleverTap, Braze, or similar, and comfortable reading a funnel or cohort without translation.

  • Energized, not unsettled, by ambiguity. You'll work across two pods and land in a third decision point by mid-year. If that sounds like an opportunity rather than a risk, you'll thrive here.

  • Strong enough presence to build trust quickly with senior leads across two different pods.

Location & Benefits

  • 🌍 Fully remote role within UTC -1 to UTC +3 time zones

  • 🤝 Work with diverse teams across UK, Europe, and Africa

  • 📚 Professional development programmes and coaching partnerships

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Family-friendly policies and flexible working arrangements

  • 💚 Well-being support and career growth opportunities

 

Our Mission 🌍

We create financial inclusion for the traditionally excluded through a fair, flexible, customer-centric financing model. We strive to drive greater inclusion of women, youth, and low-income communities.

 

Our Impact 💚

Our technology has created measurable change:

  • Connected 📱: 2.5 million first-time smartphone users connected

  • Prosperous 💰: 70% of customers use M-KOPA products for income generation, with 35,000+ livelihoods created for agents

  • Green 🌱: 2.1 million tonnes of CO₂ avoided through clean energy products, with over 127,700 circular economy products provided

jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Workplace Lead to join our Workplace experience team; as we scale up and drive digital and financial inclusion across our markets.


The Role

As Workplace Lead, you will create and maintain a safe, efficient and productive work environment for employees across Ghana. You will oversee workplace operations, facilities management, travel coordination, fleet administration, vendor management, and health and safety compliance. You will report to the Senior People Partner and sit within the People & Workplace Experience team.


About Us


M-KOPA is a pan-African fintech providing asset financing and credit services across Kenya, Uganda, Nigeria, Ghana and South Africa. We have reached 10 million customers, extended $2 billion+ in credit, and employ 2,300+ people alongside 35,000+ field agents. 86% of our customers report an improved quality of life, 55% access formal financial services for the first time, and 70% use our products to generate income.

This is a hybrid role, you would be working from our offices in Ghana, partnering with a diverse group of employees from our different markets and locations across the UK, Europe and Africa. You will be reporting to the Senior People Partner.

What makes this different

Most workplace roles are judged by how little goes wrong. Here, you own the whole experience: facilities, travel, fleet, vendors, safety and a team, in a company that is scaling quickly. You will have clear targets, direct influence on cost and service, and a visible part in keeping the people behind our mission performing at their best.

What You'll Do

  • Manage end-to-end business travel, negotiating with providers and ensuring policy and budget compliance.

  • Oversee daily office operations, facilities, supplies, events, maintenance and improvements.

  • Partner with the Employee Health and Safety team to maintain safety standards, regulatory compliance and timely incident resolution.

  • Oversee fleet servicing, usage, fuel costs, inspections and licensing.

  • Lead and develop workplace and administrative support teams through coaching and performance management.

  • Manage supplier contracts and performance, process invoices, and track expenses while driving cost savings.

  • Plan and deliver workplace improvement projects, and report on workplace, travel and fleet performance.

What You'll Need

  • A Bachelor’s degree in business administration, facilities management, operations management, human resources, or a related field.

  • Proven experience in workplace, facilities, office administration, or operations management.

  • Experience managing vendors, contracts, budgets and service providers.

  • Demonstrated people leadership and team management experience.

  • Strong understanding of workplace health and safety practices.

  • Excellent planning, project management and organizational skills.

The reality check

This role is demanding. You will carry travel, facilities, fleet, vendors, safety and a team at the same time, against targets that leave little room for slipping: 95% of issues resolved within SLA, facilities issues closed within 48 hours, and 100% compliance on fleet and safety inspections. You will also be expected to cut costs while keeping service standards high. If that sounds like the kind of ownership you have been missing, you are probably ready for exactly this.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer II & III (.NET)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Join our expanding engineering team!

We're hiring 2x permanent Senior Backend Engineers II & III to join our Asset Sales group as we scale one of the most important parts of M-KOPA's FinTech platform. Build distributed, event-driven microservices and help shape what AI-native engineering looks like at M-KOPA.

The Impact 💚

Your code will directly power the systems that put smartphones and e-motorbikes into the hands of Every Day Earners across Africa. We've already helped over 10 million customers access more than $2 billion in credit. It's your chance to be part of something that's literally transforming lives across an entire continent 🌍

The Opportunity

🎯 Mission-driven engineering: Every service you build helps expand financial inclusion for under-banked populations

🏆 Global recognition: Join a company named by the Financial Times as one of Africa's fastest-growing companies for five consecutive years (2022–2026)

🚀 Scale challenges: Build backend systems serving millions across multiple African markets

🤖 AI-native from day one: We're actively embracing AI as part of the engineering craft, not bolting it on

🌍 Fully distributed: Work remotely with diverse teams across UK, Europe, and Africa

What You'll Do

At M-KOPA, you'll build and operate distributed C# and .NET microservices on Azure, working within an event-driven architecture at significant scale. This is an outcomes-driven role: we care far more about the value you create than where you sit or how many hours you're online. You'll own what you build end-to-end — from idea, through implementation and deployment, into production and iteration.

Technical Environment 💻

  • Modern C# stack: Distributed C# and .NET microservices

  • Cloud & orchestration: Hosted on Azure using Kubernetes

  • Architecture: Event-driven, supporting products used at significant scale

  • Observability: Grafana, Azure Application Insights, logs, traces, and metrics

  • AI tooling: Claude and other AI tools used throughout the engineering workflow — design exploration, code generation and review, test writing, incident investigation, and technical communication

Our Engineering Approach 🚀

  • AI-native engineering: We want engineers who tinker — experimenting with new tools, agents, and workflows, and sharing what works

  • Guardrails as we accelerate: Automated tests, SLOs, alerting, observability, and deployment safeguards around everything we ship

  • Own it beyond the pull request: Design for idempotency, retries, out-of-order events, and failure modes, and know how your services behave in production

  • The Campfire Rule: Leave the systems you touch a little better than you found them

  • On-call as feedback, not heroics: Engineers who build our systems also help operate them, using incidents to make the platform more resilient

What You Need

We're looking for a senior engineer who's curious, autonomous, and highly trusted. You're comfortable owning the entire software stack — including supporting infrastructure — throughout its lifecycle, and you see production data, not just deployment, as the real measure of "done."

Required Experience:

  • Strong grasp of C# and .NET development

  • Experience with event-driven systems - We use Azure Service Bus, but would love to hear from you if you have experience with similar messaging technology (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.)

  • Microservices architecture experience, ideally on Azure and Kubernetes

  • Experience using observability tooling (e.g. Grafana, Application Insights) to understand production behaviour

  • Comfort using AI tools as part of a daily engineering workflow (design, code review, testing, incident investigation)

  • DevOps culture mindset, including on-call/production ownership

  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively in distributed teams across time zones

  • Continuous learning mindset and openness to feedback

Location & Benefits

  • Fully remote role, collaborating during core GMT working hours

  • Benefits package, which includes Bonus, Growth Shares & On-Call Allowance

  • Work with diverse teams distributed across UK, Europe, and Africa

  • Personalised training budget to support your development

  • Home office setup budget

  • Professional development programs and coaching partnerships

  • Family-friendly policies and flexible working arrangements

  • Well-being support and career growth opportunities

Our Mission 🌍

We create financial inclusion for the traditionally excluded through a fair, flexible, customer-centric financing model. We strive to drive greater inclusion of women, youth, and low-income communities.

Our Impact 💚

Our technology has created measurable change:

  • Connected 📱: 2.5 million first-time smartphone users connected

  • Prosperous 💰: 70% of customers use M-KOPA products for income generation, with 35,000 livelihoods created for agents

  • Green 🌱: 2.155 million tonnes of CO₂ avoided since 2010 through clean energy, refurbished devices, and e-mobility

jobs.title: Shared Services Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Shared Services Manager to join our People Team; as we scale up and drive digital and financial inclusion across our markets.

About Us

M-KOPA now serves 10 million customers and has extended $2 billion+ in credit across Kenya, Uganda, Nigeria, Ghana and South Africa. 86% of customers report an improved quality of life, 55% access formal financial services for the first time, and 70% use our products to earn income. It takes 2,300+ employees and 35,000+ field agents to make that happen.

The Role

Reporting to the Head of HR Shared Services, you lead day-to-day service delivery: queue health, SLAs, escalations, quality and business continuity, with functional leadership and coaching for colleagues. You also own UK HR operations, from onboarding and right-to-work to payroll and benefits cover, offboarding and contractors. You partner with People Partners, Talent Acquisition, Payroll, Finance, Legal, IT and external partners including the Home Office, our payroll provider, Papaya, brokers, insurers and NEST. Success means healthy queues, SLAs met and 100% audit-ready right-to-work records.

This is a remote role, you would be working with a diverse group of other employees working remotely from locations such as UK, Europe and Africa. You will be reporting to the Head of HR Shared Services.

Why this timing matters

We are not hiring at random. Reaching 10 by 10 means building the people infrastructure behind our growth. A UK team that delivers onboarding, immigration, payroll and benefits to audit-ready standards is part of that foundation, and you would help set it.

What makes this different

Your current role: one process, one market. This role: leading HR Shared Services across global and market client groups, while owning UK HR operations and compliance. Every case you close helps someone who is helping deliver financial inclusion.

What You'll Do

  • Lead HR Shared Services delivery in Freshservice, managing case allocation, prioritisation, SLAs, ageing items and escalations, and coordinating capacity during peaks and absences.

  • Own UK right-to-work checks and immigration records through the Home Office portal, including annual audits, pre-expiry follow-up, Certificates of Sponsorship and sponsor reporting.

  • Run UK onboarding from accepted offer to first-day readiness, creating accurate HiBob profiles with Talent Acquisition, IT and hiring managers.

  • Manage employee lifecycle transactions, contracts, probation, letters and audit-ready HR records, reconciling data across HiBob, Freshservice and payroll files.

  • Act as UK backup for payroll, Group Benefits, NEST pensions, Global Mobility and employee relations, supporting inputs, provider deadlines and compliant case documentation.

  • Coordinate offboarding for UK employees, EOR workers and contractors, and maintain the UK Contractor List as the source of truth.

  • Produce regular reports, close audit findings, maintain SOPs and the knowledge base, and improve processes while protecting data under UK GDPR.

What You'll Need

  • A Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Employment Relations or a related field. CIPD qualification or progress toward it is desirable.

  • Proven experience managing end-to-end HR Shared Services across multiple processes, stakeholders and client groups, including queues, SLAs, escalations, controls and continuous improvement.

  • Practical UK experience in right-to-work checks, immigration records, sponsorship administration and Home Office processes.

  • Experience coordinating UK payroll inputs, benefits, pensions, contracts, onboarding, lifecycle changes and offboarding with external providers.

  • Experience with HRIS and service-management platforms. HiBob and Freshservice are preferred.

  • Strong attention to detail, stakeholder management, sound judgement and high standards of confidentiality. Experience working across countries or markets is strongly preferred.

The reality check

This role is demanding. You will run a global service queue and a UK compliance portfolio at the same time, with competing priorities, high-volume requests and confidential cases arriving together. Right-to-work and sponsorship deadlines don’t move, and as payroll backup your accuracy shows up in someone’s payslip. When colleagues are away, you are the cover for payroll, benefits, mobility and employee relations. If you are already the person who tracks every expiry date and closes every loop, you’re probably ready for exactly this.

Why M-KOPA?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.

Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at m-kopa.com.

jobs.title: Sales Trainer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Sales Trainer to join our Sales Team; as we scale up and drive digital and financial inclusion across our markets.


The role

As Sales Trainer, you equip our sales force in your region with the tools, skills and knowledge to sell new and existing products well. You will raise the productivity of new DSRs, make sure newly recruited DSRs convert, and support sales activity across the region. You sit in the Sales department and report to the Regional Sales Training Lead.

About Us

M-KOPA is a pan-African fintech providing asset financing and credit to underserved customers. We have reached 10 million customers and extended $2B+ in credit. 86% of customers report a better quality of life, and 55% are accessing financial services for the first time. Our 2,300+ employees and 35,000+ field agents make it happen, and the Direct Sales Representatives (DSRs) you train are where every customer relationship begins.

This is a hybrid role, you would be working from our offices in Ghana, partnering with a diverse group of employees from our different markets and locations across the UK, Europe and Africa. You will be reporting to the Head of Sales.

What You'll Do

  • Own the conversion of every newly recruited DSR, measured by F7 (at least 1 sale within 7 days of registration), F30 (at least 8 sales within 30 days) and F60 (at least 8 sales in the next calendar month after F30).

  • Deliver regular in-class onboarding per territory each month, plus DSR career training and FSM/SE training as required. Teach proper onboarding and KYC fidelity so Quality of Sales reaches 95%.

  • Build the annual training calendar from needs surveys, assessments and feedback. Define clear outcomes with stakeholders, design training that can be applied the day after, and document your results.

  • Keep DSRs informed during outages such as system downtime, credits not updating or internet issues.

  • Reach at least 80% satisfaction and make sure every team is trained and ready to perform.

What You'll Need

  • At least a bachelor’s degree from a recognised university and at least 18 months as a Sales Trainer.

  • Strong command of Learning Management Systems, excellent presentation and MS PowerPoint skills, and solid business strategy, reporting, coaching and data analysis skills.

  • Self-motivation, a drive for results and a professional approach. You can train effectively in English and a local language, and Twi is an added advantage.



The honest part
This role is accountable. Your DSR conversion numbers are visible, the 95% Quality of Sales and 80% satisfaction targets are real, and outages will ask you to communicate clearly at short notice. If you want your training judged by what your people go on to sell, you’re probably ready for exactly this.

jobs.descriptionHtml:

You’re good at keeping everything running. What if you also got to design how it runs?

M-KOPA serves 7 million customers and has unlocked $2+ billion in credit, and 86% of customers report a better quality of life. We have 2,300+ employees and 35,000 agents. Behind that scale sits a Workplaces function that has to be safe, dependable and audit ready. We’re hiring a leader to run it deliberately, as we prepare for our next stage of growth.

What makes this different

You’d own fleet, corporate travel, facilities, administration, meals, events and guest services as one function, with the strategy, standards and budget to match.

About Us

We foster a culture where commercial sharpness meets customer-centricity. Our team values data-driven decision-making, disciplined execution, and leadership that creates urgency without compromising customer trust. You'll be empowered to design campaigns, coach Team Leaders, improve processes, and drive conversion metrics that directly contribute to M-KOPA Uganda's growth and customer loyalty. Working at one of Africa's fastest-growing fintechs—recognized by the Financial Times four years running and TIME100 Most Influential Companies—your work impacts millions of Ugandan customers and the business that serves them.

At M-KOPA, our Retention Manager isn't just a telesales manager—they're the architect of a high-accountability sales culture that protects customer relationships while consistently driving repeat business and revenue growth.

What you’ll do

  • Own the fleet programme, including the lease, own or hire decision and NTSA compliance, plus oversight of executive, Board and international travel.

  • Run HQ and warehouse facilities, office moves and fit-outs, and manage the budget, vendor contracts and cost savings across all of it.

  • Lead and develop the specialist leads, and move manual reporting onto dashboards and tools like FreshService, Dynamics, HiBob and Milo.

What you bring

  • A degree in business, operations, facilities or hospitality management, or equivalent experience, plus an extensive track record in workplace, facilities, travel, fleet or administrative operations, including leading specialist teams.

  • Demonstrable experience with multi-vendor budgets, purchase-to-payment and accrual discipline, cost-based fleet and space decisions, and improving processes with data and technology.

  • Working knowledge of NTSA requirements, county permits, the Occupational Safety and Health Act 2007 and the Data Protection Act 2019, with strong discretion and a calm head in incidents.

jobs.title: Lead People Partner - Mobility
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Help us put thousands more riders on electric, and build the people playbook that takes us beyond Kenya. 🏍️⚡We’ve already financed 11,000+ electric motorcycles and we’re growing 3x year-on-year. You’ll own the people agenda as we scale in Kenya and prepare to take our model to new markets.

The Impact - Your people leadership will directly shape how Mobility hires, organises and supports the teams that put everyday riders on electric vehicles they own. Our riders save an average of $5.62 a day on fuel and maintenance, and 85% say they’re now better able to meet their household goals. Across M-KOPA, we’ve reached 10 million customers and unlocked more than $2 billion in credit. It’s your chance to be part of something that’s literally transforming lives across an entire continent 🌍

About the role

Own the people agenda for M-KOPA Mobility, the business unit that finances electric motorcycles and three-wheelers for commercial riders, as it scales in Kenya and prepares to take its model to other markets.

Mobility lets everyday riders own a productive electric vehicle through a lease-to-own plan, with insurance, warranty and service bundled in. It has financed more than 11,000 electric motorcycles in Kenya and sells through B2C and fleet partners such as Bolt. It runs as an autonomous unit inside the Group, with its own leadership team and an internal board of Group executives, and draws on Group People for systems, policy and specialist support.

Mobility is Kenya-first today and is assessing expansion into other M-KOPA markets. This role builds the people model that makes expansion repeatable: how we hire, structure and lead teams in a new market, and how we keep a frontline-heavy, partly third-party workforce compliant and engaged as it grows.

Team and reporting line

Based in Kenya. Reports to the Director of People and partners day to day with the Mobility Managing Director, General Manager, and the Mobility leadership team. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports. Works with the Group People team and the Group functions Mobility draws on, such as Finance, Legal and IT.

You'll support a fast-growing, frontline-heavy workforce that combines employees with a large third-party sales network, across sales, customer care, retail, credit and collections, and technology.

What you'll do

  • Advise the Mobility MD, GM, and leadership team on org design, workforce planning and business-aligned people strategy.

  • Build the people playbook for market entry: the roles, hiring plan, local leadership, training and compliance checklist for each new market, proven first in Kenya and adapted country by country.

  • Run the flex workforce model: the mix of employees, fixed-term contracts, third-party sales staff and casual labor, including contract caps, conversion decisions and compliance.

  • Own talent review, performance calibration and succession for Mobility, including scorecards, bonus and commission design for a sales-led workforce.

  • Lead employee relations resolution and act as the escalation point, ensuring compliance with Kenyan labor law and, as Mobility expands, the local rules in each new market.

  • Build manager capability on the ground by embedding the People Manager expectations and tools across a fast-growing manager population.

  • Lead change as the business scales, including restructures, new-market launches and cross-functional projects, working with Group People and the Mobility leadership team.

What you'll bring

Essential

  • 8+ years of progressive HR or People Partner experience, including 3 to 6+ years advising director-level or above executives in a fast-growth, matrixed organization.

  • Working knowledge of Kenyan labor law and the regulatory environment, with direct experience handling employee relations escalations end to end.

  • Experience designing, not only running, an org design, workforce planning or succession framework, with evidence that you built it.

Strong advantages

  • Experience with a frontline or sales-led workforce, including third-party or contracted sales networks.

  • Experience helping a business launch or scale in a new market, ideally across more than one African country.

  • A background in asset finance, pay-as-you-go, fintech, telco or another high-volume, field-based business.

What success looks like

First 3 months. Learn the business and build trust with the Mobility MD and leadership team. No formal objectives. The focus is the workforce mix, the sales network and the growth plan, and spotting the people risks that matter most.

By 12 months

  • Mobility has a workforce plan and people operating model that match its growth plan, with clear decisions on the mix of employees, fixed-term and third-party staff.

  • A repeatable people playbook is ready for the first expansion market.

  • Managers apply the People Manager expectations in practice, and employee relations and performance cases are declining.

  • The leadership team seeks your view before major people decisions.

Why this role

Mobility is an early-stage business unit that helps everyday riders own an electric vehicle that raises their take-home pay and cuts emissions, and it is growing fast. You'll work directly with the leadership team and shape how Mobility organizes, hires and leads as it moves beyond Kenya.

The Group provides the systems, controls and a global People team, so your time goes to the decisions that matter. You'll own the whole people agenda for the business, and the role grows as Mobility enters new markets.

Location & Benefits

  • Full-time, hybrid role in Kenya

  • Direct access to and partnership with Kenya's leadership team

  • Collaboration with a global People team across Africa and Europe

  • Professional development and coaching partnerships

  • Family-friendly policies and flexible working arrangements

  • Well-being support and career growth opportunities

     

Our Mission 🌍

We create financial inclusion for the traditionally excluded through a fair, flexible, customer-centric financing model. We strive to drive greater inclusion of women, youth, and low-income communities.

 

Our Impact 💚

  • Included 💳: $2+ billion in credit unlocked, 10 million customers reached, 10,000 new customers onboarded daily

  • Connected 📱: 2.5 million first-time smartphone users

  • Prosperous 💰: 70% of customers use their M-KOPA product for income generation, with 35,000+ livelihoods created for agents

  • Sustainable 🌱: 2.155 million tonnes of CO₂ avoided since 2010, with 127,700+ circular economy products sold

 

Ready to take the step up and shape the people strategy behind Africa’s electric mobility growth story? Apply now!

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.

Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at m-kopa.com.

[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1d985516-2a99-43c0-b591-957f5adaceb9/98cde4bc-fa0a-4874-a12e-0db70c8c4abf/image.png]



The Impact - Your people leadership will directly shape how Mobility hires, organises and supports the teams that put everyday riders on electric vehicles they own. Our riders save an average of $5.62 a day on fuel and maintenance, and 85% say they’re now better able to meet their household goals. Across M-KOPA, we’ve reached 10 million customers and unlocked more than $2 billion in credit. It’s your chance to be part of something that’s literally transforming lives across an entire continent 🌍



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1d985516-2a99-43c0-b591-957f5adaceb9/98cde4bc-fa0a-4874-a12e-0db70c8c4abf/image.png]




ABOUT THE ROLE

Own the people agenda for M-KOPA Mobility, the business unit that finances electric motorcycles and three-wheelers for commercial riders, as it scales in Kenya and prepares to take its model to other markets.

Mobility lets everyday riders own a productive electric vehicle through a lease-to-own plan, with insurance, warranty and service bundled in. It has financed more than 11,000 electric motorcycles in Kenya and sells through B2C and fleet partners such as Bolt. It runs as an autonomous unit inside the Group, with its own leadership team and an internal board of Group executives, and draws on Group People for systems, policy and specialist support.

Mobility is Kenya-first today and is assessing expansion into other M-KOPA markets. This role builds the people model that makes expansion repeatable: how we hire, structure and lead teams in a new market, and how we keep a frontline-heavy, partly third-party workforce compliant and engaged as it grows.




TEAM AND REPORTING LINE

Based in Kenya. Reports to the Director of People and partners day to day with the Mobility Managing Director, General Manager, and the Mobility leadership team. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports. Works with the Group People team and the Group functions Mobility draws on, such as Finance, Legal and IT.

You'll support a fast-growing, frontline-heavy workforce that combines employees with a large third-party sales network, across sales, customer care, retail, credit and collections, and technology.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Advise the Mobility MD, GM, and leadership team on org design, workforce planning and business-aligned people strategy.

 - Build the people playbook for market entry: the roles, hiring plan, local leadership, training and compliance checklist for each new market, proven first in Kenya and adapted country by country.

 - Run the flex workforce model: the mix of employees, fixed-term contracts, third-party sales staff and casual labor, including contract caps, conversion decisions and compliance.

 - Own talent review, performance calibration and succession for Mobility, including scorecards, bonus and commission design for a sales-led workforce.

 - Lead employee relations resolution and act as the escalation point, ensuring compliance with Kenyan labor law and, as Mobility expands, the local rules in each new market.

 - Build manager capability on the ground by embedding the People Manager expectations and tools across a fast-growing manager population.

 - Lead change as the business scales, including restructures, new-market launches and cross-functional projects, working with Group People and the Mobility leadership team.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

Essential

 - 8+ years of progressive HR or People Partner experience, including 3 to 6+ years advising director-level or above executives in a fast-growth, matrixed organization.

 - Working knowledge of Kenyan labor law and the regulatory environment, with direct experience handling employee relations escalations end to end.

 - Experience designing, not only running, an org design, workforce planning or succession framework, with evidence that you built it.

Strong advantages

 - Experience with a frontline or sales-led workforce, including third-party or contracted sales networks.

 - Experience helping a business launch or scale in a new market, ideally across more than one African country.

 - A background in asset finance, pay-as-you-go, fintech, telco or another high-volume, field-based business.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



First 3 months. Learn the business and build trust with the Mobility MD and leadership team. No formal objectives. The focus is the workforce mix, the sales network and the growth plan, and spotting the people risks that matter most.

By 12 months

 - Mobility has a workforce plan and people operating model that match its growth plan, with clear decisions on the mix of employees, fixed-term and third-party staff.

 - A repeatable people playbook is ready for the first expansion market.

 - Managers apply the People Manager expectations in practice, and employee relations and performance cases are declining.

 - The leadership team seeks your view before major people decisions.




WHY THIS ROLE

Mobility is an early-stage business unit that helps everyday riders own an electric vehicle that raises their take-home pay and cuts emissions, and it is growing fast. You'll work directly with the leadership team and shape how Mobility organizes, hires and leads as it moves beyond Kenya.

The Group provides the systems, controls and a global People team, so your time goes to the decisions that matter. You'll own the whole people agenda for the business, and the role grows as Mobility enters new markets.



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1d985516-2a99-43c0-b591-957f5adaceb9/86f7fe83-cdac-44e5-95f4-5cfc1d36c035/image.png]




LOCATION & BENEFITS

 - Full-time, hybrid role in Kenya

 - Direct access to and partnership with Kenya's leadership team

 - Collaboration with a global People team across Africa and Europe

 - Professional development and coaching partnerships

 - Family-friendly policies and flexible working arrangements

 - Well-being support and career growth opportunities
   
    


OUR MISSION 🌍

We create financial inclusion for the traditionally excluded through a fair, flexible, customer-centric financing model. We strive to drive greater inclusion of women, youth, and low-income communities.

 

Our Impact 💚

 - Included 💳: $2+ billion in credit unlocked, 10 million customers reached, 10,000 new customers onboarded daily

 - Connected 📱: 2.5 million first-time smartphone users

 - Prosperous 💰: 70% of customers use their M-KOPA product for income generation, with 35,000+ livelihoods created for agents

 - Sustainable 🌱: 2.155 million tonnes of CO₂ avoided since 2010, with 127,700+ circular economy products sold

 

Ready to take the step up and shape the people strategy behind Africa’s electric mobility growth story? Apply now! 




WHY M-KOPA?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.



Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at m-kopa.com http://m-kopa.com.

jobs.title: Regional Retail Team Lead
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Regional Retail Team Lead to join our Retail team as we scale up and drive digital and financial inclusion across our markets.

You already run a tight operation. Your counts reconcile, your people show up, your stock moves. But when did you last see a shelf you managed change what a family could afford?

Why this timing matters

M-KOPA now serves 7 million customers, up from 5 million in 2024, and has unlocked $2+ billion in credit. 86% of customers report an improved quality of life, and 55% are using a product or service for the first time. Every one of those devices sits in a shop before it reaches a customer.

If you have noticed us hiring across several roles, that is deliberate. We are building the infrastructure for the road from 5 million to 7 million to 10 million customers, and retail is where much of that infrastructure physically lives.

What makes this role different

A typical stock role: you inherit the plan, count what is on the shelf and report the variance. This role: you write the plan. You lead the Stock Controllers across a whole region, decide where inventory goes, approve corrective action when numbers drift, and shortlist the next shop location. Landlords, sales leaders, audit and finance all know your name, because you are the regional point of contact.

Why this work matters

Financial inclusion is easy to say and hard to deliver. It comes down to a customer walking into a shop and finding the right device, in stock, on the day they need it. Many of our customers use their products to earn an income, and for more than half it is their first time accessing a product or service like this. When allocation runs late, a shop closes without warning or a Stock Controller has no working tool, that customer is the one who waits. You are the person who makes sure they don’t.

Who you will work with

You report to the Retail Operations Manager and lead the Stock Controllers in your region. Day to day, you sit between the shop floor and the wider business: Area Sales Managers and Direct Sales Representatives on one side, and warehouse, audit, quality, customer service, finance and HR on the other. You also propose changes to SOPs, processes and tools based on what you see in your region, and those proposals get heard.

What you will do

  • Lead the people. Supervise, coach and develop the Stock Controllers in your region through one-on-ones, performance reviews and individual development plans, while managing shift cover, leave and workload across every outlet. You are the escalation point for people issues, the trainer who onboards new joiners, cascades every new SOP and runs refreshers and knowledge assessments, and the person who recommends promotions, performance plans or disciplinary action.

  • Own the stock. Track ageing reports and loss trends, then act before targets slip: demand-based allocation, FIFO enforcement and moving slow stock between outlets. Investigate every discrepancy to its root cause, enforce the Stock Management Policy (daily counts, reconciliation, secure storage), and report risks, trends and recommended actions, including write-offs, to the Retail Operations Manager.

  • Keep shops standing and the field supplied. Work shoulder to shoulder with Area Sales Managers and Direct Sales Representatives on allocation SLAs, outstanding devices and joint planning against sales targets, and mediate when stock and sales disagree. Manage landlords and leases so no shop faces sudden displacement, lead relocations, keep every outlet branded and audited, and run the work tools register so no Stock Controller is ever without a working tool.

What you bring

  • Demonstrable experience in retail operations, inventory or stock management, or supply chain coordination, including time leading a team. Managing people across several locations, and a background in high-volume consumer retail or fintech, will put you ahead. You motivate diverse teams, communicate clearly across functions, and handle conflict and negotiation, especially with landlords and cross-functional partners.

  • Sharp analytical and problem-solving skills: you read stock and ageing data and turn it into action. You are proficient in inventory management systems and Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook), organized enough to juggle competing priorities, and driven by creative, strategic thinking and continuous improvement.

  • A Bachelor’s degree in business administration, supply chain management, logistics, retail management or a related field from a recognized university. Professional certification in inventory management (CPIM, CSCP) or project management (PMP, PRINCE2) is an added advantage.

The reality check

This role is demanding. You will cover many outlets at once, and in the same week you may be coaching a Stock Controller, negotiating with a landlord and explaining a variance to the Retail Operations Manager. When stock goes missing, you are the one who finds out why. If that sounds like the kind of problem you enjoy, you are probably ready for exactly this.

Ready to run the retail backbone behind 7 million customers? Let’s talk.

Why M-KOPA?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.

Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at m-kopa.com.

Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026), named on CNBC's World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025 & 2026 and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 10 million customers, unlocking $2 billion in cumulative credit for the everyday earners across Africa, in addition to over 10,000 e-bikes financed in Kenya.

Important Notice

M-KOPA is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to assembling a diverse, broadly trained staff. Women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.

M-KOPA explicitly prohibits the use of Forced or Child Labour and respects the rights of its employees to agree to terms and conditions of employment voluntarily, without coercion, and freely terminate their employment on appropriate notice. M-KOPA shall ensure that its Employees are of legal working age and shall comply with local laws for youth employment or student work, such as internships or apprenticeships. 

M-KOPA does not collect/charge any money as a pre-employment or post-employment requirement. This means that we never ask for ‘recruitment fees’, ‘processing fees’, ‘interview fees’, or any other kind of money in exchange for offer letters or interviews at any time during the hiring process.

Applications for this position will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisting and interviews will take place at any stage during the recruitment process. We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if a suitable candidate is selected before the advertised closing date.

If your application is successful M-KOPA undertakes pre-employment background checks as part of its recruitment process, these include; criminal records, identification verification, academic qualifications, employment dates and employer references.
